> Organize and maintain a structured library of edited images and videos, ensuring files are properly labeled with correct file naming conventions.

> Stay updated with industry trends, design techniques, and emerging technologies to bring innovative ideas and fresh perspectives to the team.

> Ensure that all project tasks and asset deliverables are completed to specification, pixel-perfect, and on-time.

> Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communication, OR equivalent art portfolio.

> 5+ years professional experience in a photo graphic design role or related position.

> Advanced proficiency in the Adobe Creative Suite including: Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, and InDesign.

> Expert skills in image retouching and editing.

> A keen attention to detail, and a desire to continually collaborate, create, develop, and grow creative initiatives within a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.

description:
Location



Remote (Philippines)



Salary



$2,000 USD per month



Hours



Full-time

UK Hours (8:00am – 5:00pm GMT/BST)

Daily tea
etings required





About Us



We are a fast-growing marketing agency based in Dubai that helps roofing companies across the UK generate more leads, more appointments, and more roofing jobs through Meta advertising.



We currently work with approximately 30 active clients and have a team of 7 specialists covering paid advertising, CRM automation, lead nurturing, appointment setting, and operations.



We’re now looking for an exceptional Meta Ads specialist to take ownership of our clients’ advertising performance.



This is not a junior media buyer role.



This is not a role where you’ll be handed SOPs and told exactly what to do.



We’re looking for someone who can confidently walk into an account, identify opportunities, build winning campaigns, improve results, and drive measurable growth with minimal supervision.





Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for an A-player.



Someone who genuinely understands Meta lead generation better than the average agency owner, media buyer, or freelancer.



You should be highly analytical, highly proactive, and comfortable making decisions based on data.



You should have significant experience generating leads for service-based businesses using Meta Ads and be able to explain exactly why campaigns succeed or fail.



If you’ve worked with roofing companies, home improvement companies, contractors, trades, or local service businesses, that’s a major advantage.





Minimum Requirements



Essential



* 5+ years running Meta Ads professionally

* Managed at least $5M USD in Meta ad spend throughout your career

* Extensive experience with lead generation campaigns

* Strong experience working with local service businesses

* Deep understanding of Meta Ads Manager

* Strong understanding of campaign structure, optimisation, scaling, and testing

* Proven track record generating qualified leads consistently

* Excellent written English

* Comfortable working UK business hours

* Able to join daily team calls

* Able to work independently without constant management



Preferred



* Experience with roofing companies

* Experience with home improvement businesses

* Experience with high-ticket lead generation

* Experience working within agencies managing multiple client accounts

* Experience using GoHighLevel





Your Responsibilities



Meta Campaign Management



* Build and launch Meta advertising campaigns

* Manage and optimise existing campaigns

* Monitor daily performance across all client accounts

* Scale successful campaigns

* Identify underperforming campaigns and improve results

* Conduct ongoing split testing

* Monitor lead quality and not just lead volume

* Make strategic recommendations based on data



Creative Strategy



* Develop new ad angles and campaign concepts

* Write compelling ad copy

* Create hooks and offers

* Brief our video editor on winning creatives

* Analyse creative performance and iterate quickly



Performance Analysis



* Track KPIs across all accounts

* Analyse lead quality

* Monitor CPL, conversion rates, booked appointments, and revenue outcomes

* Produce clear recommendations for improving results

* Identify trends across multiple accounts



Client Success



* Ensure clients receive consistent lead flow

* Take ownership of campaign performance

* Work closely with our internal team to maximise results

* Contribute ideas that improve client outcomes





What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days:



* Take ownership of approximately 30 client accounts

* Improve campaign consistency across accounts

* Reduce wasted ad spend

* Increase lead quality

* Implement a structured testing framework

* Introduce creative strategies that improve conversion rates

* Become the go-to Meta advertising expert within the company





What We Don’t Want



This role is NOT suitable for:



* Beginners

* General virtual assistants

* People who only know how to duplicate campaigns

* Media buyers who rely entirely on SOPs

* People who need constant supervision

* Anyone without significant lead generation experience





How To Apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV

2. A Loom video (5–10 minutes)

3. Total Meta ad spend managed

4. Industries you’ve worked with

5. Your three best lead generation case studies

6. The highest-performing campaign you’ve ever managed

7. The average monthly ad spend you currently manage

8. Why you believe you’re qualified for this role



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.





Final Note



We’re building a long-term team of exceptional people.



If you’re someone who takes ownership, loves solving problems, thrives on performance data, and knows how to generate high-quality leads through Meta Ads, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Director of Digital Operations & AI Product Launch (Integrator)
description:
I’m building and scaling a multi-brand ecosystem across publishing, AI products, wellness, and curriculum. The ideas and assets exist. The problem is execution at scale.

I’m looking for a senior-level operator who can own the execution of multiple tech-heavy, revenue-focused projects—from AI chatbots and digital funnels to telehealth and curriculum platforms.

If you’ve run complex digital launches, managed cross-functional teams, and turned chaos into shipped products and recurring revenue, keep reading.

You are not a VA, “online assistant,” or someone who only takes orders.

You are the person who can take goals ? design a plan ? drive people and tech until it’s live and producing results.

________________________________________

Core Projects You’ll Help Execute (First 6–12 Months)

You won’t do every task yourself—but you’ll be responsible for making sure these move from “in progress” to “live and producing”:

• Thug Series GPT – AI assistant + funnel for a bestselling Street Lit universe.

• SmartClient Bots – AI/automation builds for clients using tools like GoHighLevel and GPT.

• MyCondolences – Tech-enabled condolence/memorial service (potential pet pivot).

• Walk In Wellness Virtual Clinic / TPA – Telehealth front-end, intake, and provider onboarding systems.

• Transform Curriculum – Digital/self-paced curriculum portal for schools and programs.

• NWNOI Funnel Launch – Donations + book sales + simple nurturing flows.

• Publishing CEO / New Book Releases – Launch systems for new titles.

• W.C. Global Strategy Offers – Strategy/consulting offers with clear funnels and onboarding.

________________________________________

Key Outcomes (First 90 Days)

In your first 90 days, success looks like:

• Clarity & Plan

o Each of the priority projects above has:

? A simple, written roadmap

? Defined milestones

? Owners for each task (you, me, VAs, vendors)

• Shipped Assets

o At least 2–3 offers/funnels are live and capable of collecting leads and payments (e.g., W.C. Global Strategy offer, SmartClient Bots, Thug Series GPT beta).

• Operational Rhythm

o A weekly reporting system:

? What was done

? What’s blocked

? What’s next

o Clear expectations for VAs and contractors.

I’m not interested in “activity.” I’m interested in shipped, working systems.

________________________________________

Responsibilities

• Project & Operations Leadership

o Turn high-level goals into clear project plans, timelines, and weekly priorities.

o Coordinate across me, designers, VAs, devs, and specialists.

o Keep multiple projects moving without dropping details.

• Digital & AI Product Execution

o Oversee the setup of AI tools (GPT-based products, bots, automation flows).

o Work with technical implementers to configure and test:

? Chatbots / GPT flows

? GoHighLevel automations

? Landing pages, payment links, and onboarding sequences.

• Launch & Funnel Management

o Plan and oversee launches for:

? Consulting offers (W.C. Global Strategy)

? Book and IP-based products

? AI-based services (SmartClient Bots, Thug Series GPT)

o Coordinate
 campaigns, simple ads, and basic analytics.

• Systems & Documentation

o Create and refine SOPs so projects can be handed off and scaled.

o Clean up and simplify our existing project trackers so everyone knows what matters now.

• Reporting & Accountability

o Run a weekly check-in:

? Status by project

? Bottlenecks and decisions needed

? Risks and tradeoffs

o Hold tea
mbers (and me) accountable to agreed priorities.

________________________________________

Must-Haves

• Proven experience running multi-project digital operations:

o Agency, online education, SaaS, or info-product background is ideal.

• You’ve launched offers/funnels before:

o You understand the basic pieces: offer ? landing page ? checkout ? delivery ? follow-up.

• Strong familiarity with AI + automation tools, such as:

o ChatGPT/GPT-based products

o GoHighLevel (or similar CRMs/automation tools)

o Basic API/automation logic (you don’t need to write code, but you need to think like a builder).

• You can plan AND execute:

o You’re comfortable writing a roadmap and then getting into the tools or directing others to finish.

• You are direct, organized, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment.

o This is not a corporate, slow-moving culture.

________________________________________

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience in any of these domains:

o Publishing / authors / book launches

o Mental health / telehealth / wellness services

o Curriculum / EdTech

• Experience managing:

o Remote teams

o VAs and specialized freelancers

o Light ad spend (Meta, Amazon Ads, Google)

________________________________________

Working Style & Expectations

• Remote, flexible, but with agreed core hours for communication.

• You’re comfortable with voice/video check-ins and written updates.

o “Here’s the issue, here are 2–3 options, here’s my recommendation.”

title: Virtual Assistant – Buyer Transactions & Real Estate Operations

The Michael Klein Group is seeking an organized, responsive, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our buyer transactions and real estate operations. Our team specializes in investment properties, short-term rentals, vacation homes, new construction and land throughout the Poconos.

You will help our agents and buyers research properties, prepare offers, coordinate inspections and due diligence, and keep transactions moving forward. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently, managing deadlines, communicating professionally, and learning Pennsylvania real estate forms and procedures.



Responsibilities

Gather property information from the MLS, listing agents, public records, and other sources.

Request and organize seller disclosures, rental revenue, permit information, utility details, and answers to buyer questions.

Track important offer and transaction deadlines.

Assist with land purchases, including preparing draft offers and organizing property due diligence.

Help complete and submit municipal, zoning, building, septic, and other permit applications.

Schedule perc tests, surveys, wetland studies, and other land-related inspections.

Communicate with townships, engineers, surveyors, septic professionals, and environmental consultants.

Prepare and coordinate mailers to landowners for potential off-market acquisitions.

Maintain accurate buyer records, property notes, task lists, and transaction files.

Assist with urgent offers and transaction-related issues on evenings or weekends when necessary.



Qualifications

Excellent written and spoken English, little to no accent.

Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.

Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple buyers and deadlines.

Professional communication skills when contacting agents, municipalities, vendors, and clients.

Experience with Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Gmail.

Comfortable learning MLS platforms/Flex/Bright, electronic-signature software/Dotloop, CRM systems/Lofty, and real estate websites.

Able to conduct online research and summarize information clearly.

Reliable internet connection and dependable computer setup.

Willing and able to work weekends when offers or urgent tasks arise.

Able to protect confidential client and transaction information.



Preferred Experience

Previous experience as a real estate virtual assistant, transaction coordinator, or administrative assistant.

Familiarity with Pennsylvania real estate transactions and PAR forms.

Experience preparing draft offers or buyer agreements.

Experience with land, zoning, septic systems, surveys, perc testing, wetlands, or municipal permitting.

Familiarity with investment properties or short-term rentals.

Experience communicating with listing agents and service providers.



What Success Looks Like

Buyer questions are researched and answered promptly.

Due-diligence folders are complete, accurate, and easy to navigate.

New listings are identified quickly and matched with the appropriate buyers.

Draft offers and agreements are prepared accurately and on time.

title: Virtual Assistant Accountant
description:
LEAP HOUSING

Virtual Assistant Accountant

Remote · Part-Time (20–30 hrs/week)





ABOUT LEAP HOUSING

LEAP Housing is a Boise, Idaho, USA  based 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to developing and preserving affordable housing across the state. Our vision is to see communities transformed by hope, connection, and stable housing, and we pursue that vision through creative, business-minded solutions to one of the most pressing crises in our state and country.



We’re a small team, and we’re intentional about that. At LEAP, we only hire unicorns—people who are genuinely rare: sharp with numbers, warm with people, adaptable under pressure, and motivated by work that matters. Everyone on our team owns their role fully. You won’t find duplicate positions or bureaucratic layers here. What you will find is a team that shows up for each other, communicates honestly, and genuinely cares about the people sitting next to them.



If you want to be more than a cog in a machine, if you want to understand the “why” behind the work, if you want to grow professionally every year and be part of something that changes lives, you’ve found your team.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re hiring a Virtual Assistant Accountant to work directly with our Senior Accountant and support the financial operations of the organization. This is a part-time role: approximately 20 hours per week with the potential to grow into a full-time position as our needs expand.



Right now, our accounting function depends heavily on our Senior Accountant preparing and reviewing everything herself. That creates a bottleneck—especially around month-end close, when we’re working toward our 20th-of-the-month deadline while other time-sensitive needs keep surfacing. You’ll come in and take real ownership of key preparation tasks, giving the Senior Accountant the time back she needs for higher-level analysis and decision support.



This isn’t busywork. You’ll be preparing reports that go to management and the board, supporting our annual audit, and helping us track performance across multiple projects. You’ll also be the second set of eyes that makes our financial reporting more reliable—a critical function in a nonprofit where accuracy and trust go hand in hand.



SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

This is a part-time role with flexible hours, but U.S. time zone overlap is important, especially at the start.



- Approximately 20 hours per week to start, with potential to increase to 30 hours during audit season or periods of high activity

- During onboarding: approximately 75% of hours should overlap with U.S. Mountain Time business hours 

- Once established: approximately 50% overlap with U.S. business hours, with the remainder flexible

- Daily communication via
 or messaging is expected. You should be reachable and responsive during your overlap hours

- Weekly virtual check-in with Senior Accountant (minimum); additional daily
 updates are preferred

- Month-end close typically requires heavier availability around the 15th–20th of each month and audit fieldwork in February and March —plan accordingly. 



WHAT YOU'LL DO

LEAP operates across multiple QuickBooks Online (QBO) entities and a growing portfolio of housing projects. Your work will touch all of them. Tasks are structured and recurring, but this is not a purely mechanical role; you’ll be expected to think critically, flag discrepancies, and bring solutions alongside problems.



1. Month-End Close Support (Primary Responsibility)

- Prepare monthly financial statements and reports in QuickBooks Online across LEAP’s five entities, with primary activity in two entities

- Support month-end close tasks to ensure books are closed by the 20th of each month

- Aid in managing intercompany transactions across entities

- Prepare and analyze cash flow forecasts versus actuals

- Flag discrepancies early and bring Senior Accountant a clear explanation plus a suggested path forward



2. Reporting & Financial Analysis

- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for management, board meetings, and external stakeholders

- Prepare quarterly budget vs. actuals analysis to track performance against organizational goals

- Support reporting requirements for government agencies, funders, and grant compliance

- Conduct financial analysis to identify trends, cost-saving opportunities, and areas of risk



3. Affordable Housing Project Support

- Assist with draw requests for affordable housing development projects, including tying out development analyst schedules to QBO and budget vs. actuals

- Maintain detailed records of draw requests, approvals, and disbursements

- Collaborate with the development analyst on construction budget tracking as the role grows



4. Audit & Compliance Support

- Aid in LEAP’s annual audit process by preparing documentation and supporting schedules for auditors

- Maintain compliance with grant awards

- Support tax filing preparation, grant reporting requirements, and other regulatory obligations



5. Budgeting & Planning Support

- Collaborate with the asset management team to refine annual budgets and monitor actuals

- Provide support in budget preparation and monitoring to ensure alignment with organizational goals



What This Role Does NOT Include

To be clear about scope:



No authority to approve banking transactions, move funds, or make final accounting decisions—you can prepare and request; Senior Accountant and leadership approve

No supervision of other tea
mbers

No travel required

No external communication beyond occasional
 clarifications with outside parties



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

LEAP hires unicorns. That’s not just a saying, it shapes how we think about every hire. For this role specifically, we need someone who combines technical accounting skill with genuine intellectual curiosity and the kind of initiative that doesn’t need to be prompted.



You’re a Fit If You:

- Hold a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a closely related field (required)

- Are a CPA or actively pursuing CPA certification (strongly preferred)

- Have at least 2 years of accounting experience, ideally with a U.S.-based organization—nonprofit experience is a strong plus

- Are proficient in QuickBooks Online (required) and comfortable in 
 and Google Suite

- Have strong English communication skills, written and verbal—you’ll be working closely with the Senior Accountant and occasionally with other tea
mbers and external parties

- Are naturally detail-oriented and accurate, but also able to zoom out and understand the “why” behind the numbers

- See a problem and come to your manager with a suggested solution, not just the problem itself

- Are proactive about improving processes, not just maintaining them

- Can work independently once trained and take full ownership of delegated tasks

- Are comfortable with recurring structure AND with adapting when new reporting needs arise

- Have your own reliable computer, internet, and a private, professional workspace



This Role Is NOT a Fit If You:

- Need to be told every step to take and cannot self-direct once trained

- Are resistant to process changes or organizational growth

- Have weak English communication—we are not bilingual, and clarity matters

- Take a “that’s not my job” approach—everyone at LEAP wears multiple hats and supports each other

- Are looking for a purely repetitive, check-the-box role with no critical thinking involved



TOOLS YOU'LL WORK WITH

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is required on day one. Everything else can be learned, but comfort with modern technology and cloud-based tools is essential.



- QuickBooks Online (QBO): primary accounting platform across LEAP’s five entities (required)

- 
: accounts payable and payment processing

- Google Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Sheets (daily use)

- Banking platforms: for record review and reconciliation (view access only)

- Scribe or similar documentation tools: for building out process documentation



YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Onboarding takes time here—we know that, and we’re committed to setting you up to succeed. LEAP operates across multiple entities with a growing project portfolio, and understanding how it all fits together is the foundation for everything else.



- Month 1 (Days 1–30): Shadow Senior Accountant’s workflows; learn LEAP’s five QuickBooks entities and how they relate; identify the top three to five revenue sources and major expenditure categories; understand how each report serves the organization

- Month 2 (Days 31–60): Begin preparing reports with Senior Accountant reviewing; start month-end close tasks with guidance; ask questions early and often—we’d rather you ask than guess

- Month 3 (Days 61–90): Take increasing ownership of preparation tasks; Senior Accountant moves from doing to reviewing; formal 90-day performance check-in



We want you asking deep questions. If at 90 days you can tell us not just what the numbers say but why they matter, we’ll know you’re on the right track.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

We believe in rewarding real contribution with real compensation and in being transparent about what that looks like from day one through year five. LEAP takes care of its people, and this role is no exception.



Months 1–3 (Onboarding): $7.25/hour

After Successful Onboarding: $8.00/hour

12-Month Review: $9.00+/hour (based on performance and scope)



Raises are tied to performance, expanded responsibilities, and tenure—not just time. We want you to see exactly what you’re working toward, and we’ll build that out together in your first review.



Over the next 3 - 5 years, this individual could progress in their role with more strategically focused responsibilities at full time and at a higher compensation ranging from $34,000 USD ($2M Philippine pesos) to $45,000 USD ($2.7M Philippine pesos) annually. 



Additional Benefits

- 13th Month Bonus: One additional month’s pay at year-end, honoring a meaningful Philippine tradition

- SSS & PhilHealth Allowance: $30/month to support your government contribution programs

- 14 Floating Paid Holidays per year: We observe 14 paid holidays annually, and they’re all floating—take U.S. holidays, Philippine holidays, or personal observances that matter to you. You choose.

- Regular annual raises tied to your anniversary date and performance

- Professional development funding: approved courses, certifications, and continuing education (including CPA prep support) can be submitted for approval by your supervisor—LEAP is serious about investing in your growth, evidenced by the requirement for full time employees to have 40 hours of development improvement annually.

- Clear career progression: as LEAP grows and your role expands, your title and compensation advance with it. We’ll map that out explicitly so you always know where you stand and what’s next

- Payroll: twice-monthly (hours worked 1st–15th paid on the 20th; 16th–end of month paid on the 5th)

- Path to full-time: as LEAP’s project portfolio and team grow, this role is expected to expand; the right person will grow with it



COMMUNICATION & ACCOUNTABILITY

At LEAP, we communicate directly, support each other genuinely, and hold ourselves accountable. That culture extends to this role, even across time zones.



- Daily
 update during your overlap hours: what you completed, what you’re working on, any questions or blockers

- Weekly virtual check-in with Senior Accountant (video call). Once you’re established, this can shift to as-needed plus a written recap

- Direct access to Senior Accountant for questions and guidance. You’re expected to try first, but support is always available

- Monthly one-on-one to review your workload, performance, and professional growth

- Formal reviews at 6 months, and 12 months



We don’t believe in micromanagement, but we do believe in staying connected. The expectation is that once you’re trained, the Senior Accountant can trust that what she delegates gets done—accurately and on time—without having to follow up.



GROWTH AND LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

LEAP is growing, and this role grows with it. Right now, this is part-time and focused on core accounting support. But the trajectory is clear: as our project portfolio expands and the role proves its value, there is a realistic path to:



- Full-time employment with expanded scope

- Taking on construction budget tracking alongside our development analyst

- Supporting financial education and analysis across LEAP’s broader team

- Becoming LEAP’s in-house subject matter expert on organizational finances—the go-to person that leadership trusts for financial insight



If you’re ambitious, intellectually curious, and mission-driven, this is a role where you can genuinely build a career, not just hold a job.



To Apply, please click the following link - 



Here, you will be prompted to upload a resume, fill out an Experience Questionnaire and take a quick assessment. If you pass this first round, we will send you a few follow up assessments.



The last round will involve sending in a video recording of yourself answering a handful of questions, then finally a live face-to-face interview. Then we will make our final decision.



We genuinely read every application. If you’re a unicorn, we’ll find each other.



— The LEAP Housing Team

title: Recruiting Operations Manager/WFH/Full-Time
description:
Help Build Careers. Develop Recruiters. Impact Growing Businesses.



iCare Financial is seeking an experienced, professional, and highly motivated Recruiting Manager to lead our growing recruiting team.

You will work directly with company leadership to help build and scale our recruiting department, train future recruiters, improve hiring processes, and ensure we consistently hire exceptional Virtual Assistants for our growing company.

If you enjoy interviewing, coaching others, identifying top talent, and making hiring decisions that directly impact business success, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.



Why Join iCare Financial?



At iCare Financial, we believe that great businesses start with great people.



We have an established and unique patient financing program. Since 2011 we operate in all 50 states. We offer patients a financing program that is 0% interest, with no credit check. 



Patients love us because they can get their dental treatment with no credit check and a monthly payment they can afford. Dental practices love us because we guarantee their payments.



With great support, we provide a culture and environment for you to grow. We are rapidly expanding and plan to hire more than 100 Filipino tea
mbers over the next 18 months across customer service, loan processing, sales support, operations, and administrative roles.

You will work closely with leadership while serving as the primary decision-maker for candidate evaluations and final hiring recommendations.



You will also mentor and train new recruiters while helping improve our overall recruiting systems, tracking and processes.

mbers

Highly Preferred

mbers

title: Marketing Department Lead
description:
WHO WE ARE

We’re not a typical health clinic. 

Cerebral Health is a patient-centered neurological care organization dedicated to helping people who have not found answers through conventional treatment. We provide innovative, non-invasive therapies designed to improve neurological function, enhance quality of life, and deliver meaningful, lasting outcomes for our patients.



We’re building an in-house team that owns outcomes, not just outputs. That means the people we hire aren’t task-completers — they’re operators who understand that the quality of their work directly affects whether a patient walks through our door and gets the help they need.





THE ROLE 

This is not a closing or quota-carrying sales role. You won't be selling to patients. Your core job is to make our clinicians dramatically better at the consultative conversations that turn prospective patients into committed ones.

You'll live inside an AI-powered sales workspace, audit clinical sales conversations against proven frameworks, and deliver sharp, usable coaching straight to our doctors — holding them accountable to a high standard and tracking their improvement over time. The large majority of this work is for Cerebral Health, with a smaller portion supporting Magnolia Hyperbarics calls and check-ins.

Alongside the coaching work, you'll support our marketing team and Director of Operations on sales-driven initiatives and outreach. This is a supporting part of the role, not the center of it — the heart of the job is auditing and coaching.

Think of yourself as the coach, the quality engine, and the systems-builder behind our sales conversations. Much of this is heads-down precision work — auditing, scoring, refining — paired with the people's skill to coach skilled professionals in a way that actually changes behavior.





WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Day-to-day, here's what this looks like.

Marketing Strategy & Planning 

   • Owns: overall strategy aligned to Cerebral Health goals; audiences and personas per entity; annual and quarterly plans; budget allocation; competitive and market intelligence; the brand-awareness roadmap. 

   • Directs: research and analysis surfaced by AI tools and the team. 

AI Marketing Infrastructure & Operations (the engine of the role) 

   • Owns: personal, hands-on mastery of the advanced AI modules and tooling, run directly rather than delegated; refinement of the entity marketing workspaces already built, closing the gaps found across channels; design of automations, AI agents and workflows, CRM structure, and lead-tracking and data-integrity standards; the SOP library that lets one person produce what used to take a team, with entity context built in.

   • Directs: the recurring AI content engine — running skills such as Content Analyzer, Newsletter Writer, and SEO blog generation on a set cadence; ongoing system maintenance and improvement by the team.

Demand Generation & Funnels 

   • Owns: lead-generation strategy across inbound and outbound; funnel and conversion design; campaign strategy and budgets; the sales-handoff and lead-qualification process. Builds the marketing funnels now with hooks ready to connect to sales; the joint sales-and-marketing funnel build is held until a sales hire is in place.

   • Directs: campaign execution, ad management, and nurture run by the Paid Ads Specialist and AI systems.

   • Tracks: CPL, CAC, ROAS, MQLs, conversion rates.

Content, Brand & Creative

   • Owns: content strategy across SEO, GEO, ads, written content, video, and podcasts; brand identity, voice, and visual consistency for each entity; final approval of customer-facing material.

   • Directs: production from the Video Editor, AI generation tools, and the recurring content skills; the publishing calendar.

Website, SEO & GEO

   • Owns: website performance strategy, landing-page architecture, SEO and GEO direction, and conversion-rate optimization across entity sites.

   • Directs: build, updates, and technical execution by the Web Developer and SEO Specialist.

Analytics, Reporting & Performance

   • Owns: the marketing KPI framework and benchmarks; revenue attribution; the reporting rhythm to leadership.

   • Directs: automated dashboards and reporting built into the AI system, so accuracy is a property of the system rather than manual upkeep.

Team Enablement & Agency Transition

   • Owns: training the two new hires — the SEO Specialist and Web Developer — on the AI models and tools off the SOPs they build; developing the team's capability to operate the system independently; full capture of the outgoing agency's current processes so nothing is lost, then building beyond them; leading the transition so in-house output is fully self-sufficient ahead of the agency rolloff, with no gap.

   • Directs: goal-setting, priorities, coaching, and quality oversight for the team.

Standards & Cadence

   • Delivers work to a verified-complete standard — "done" means leadership can review it and find no gaps.

   • Understands each system fully and hands-on before refining it or declaring it ready.

   • Meets weekly with leadership during the build to bring what's built, what's stuck, and what's needed.

   • Holds brand fidelity as a hard standard: every channel and entity ships under its own context filter, and nothing generic goes out the door.



YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF...

• AI-native. You don't just use AI—you build systems around it. You're comfortable creating automations, refining AI workflows, and continuously improving how technology supports marketing operations.

• A systems thinker. You naturally build repeatable processes instead of solving the same problem twice. SOPs, workflows, automation, and operational efficiency excite you.

• A strategic marketer. You understand how every part of marketing connects—from brand awareness to demand generation, SEO, websites, content, analytics, and revenue growth.

• A builder. You thrive in environments where you're creating something from the ground up. You enjoy building departments, improving processes, and scaling operations rather than simply maintaining existing systems.

• A strong leader. You know how to develop people, create accountability, provide direction, and help specialists perform at their highest level.

• Detail-oriented. You believe complete means complete. You produce work that leadership can review with confidence because you've already thought through the details.

• A clear communicator. You communicate strategy, expectations, and feedback with clarity. You can translate complex ideas into practical directions that your team can execute.





MUST-HAVES

• Demonstrated fluency with AI tools, automation platforms, and modern marketing technology

• Proven experience building marketing systems, workflows, automations, and SOPs that improve efficiency and scalability

• Broad marketing expertise across strategy, demand generation, content, branding, SEO/GEO, websites, analytics, and digital marketing

• Experience leading and developing marketing teams while creating clear direction and accountability

• Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and scale a marketing function from the ground up

• Exceptional organizational skills and a high standard for quality and completeness

• Excellent written and verbal English communication

• Ability to work full-time on Pacific Time hours, regardless of physical location

• Reliable workspace, hardware, and internet connection





NICE-TO-HAVES

• Experience marketing within healthcare, medical, or clinical organizations

• Experience transitioning work from an external marketing agency to an internal team

• Hands-on experience producing video or podcast content

• Experience building founder-led or personality-driven brands

• Familiarity with advanced AI marketing platforms and AI-powered content generation workflows

• Experience with CRM platforms and marketing automation systems

• Experience with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)



WHAT YOU'LL GET

We take care of the people who take care of our patients.

• Paid Time Off — Recharge so you can perform at your best. We respect the time you take away from work.

• Sick Days — When life happens, it happens. Take the time you need to recover without the pressure.

• Fully Remote — Work remotely with a team spread across time zones — autonomy and flexibility built in.

• Real Growth — This is a growing organization. As both brands scale, so do the opportunities for the people building them.

• A Team That Cares — We hire people who are bought into the mission. You'll work alongside others who understand why the work matters, not just what the work is.

• A Greater Mission — Every qualified booking you drive is a patient who gets access to treatment that could change their life. That's not marketing copy — that's the reality of what we do.



HOW WE HIRE

Our interview process includes a practical working session. We'll ask you to evaluate an existing marketing system or workflow, identify opportunities for improvement, and explain how you would use AI, automation, and operational thinking to make the department more effective. This role is about building systems—not just managing campaigns—and we want to see how you think.

Due to a high number of applicants, this will be the only time we are interviewing since we will be hiring at the end of next week.



The Point Restaurant Group is a growing hospitality company specializing in high-volume events, catering, and experience-driven dining.

We operate two distinct brands:

The Point – in-house restaurant catering and private events

Blind Tiger Catering – full-service off-site catering, food, beverage, and mobile bar experiences



We handle everything from small gatherings to large-scale weddings and corporate events, with a strong focus on efficiency, organization, and conversion. Our systems, automations, and processes are already built. We are now focused on scaling bookings, improving conversion, and delivering a seamless client experience from inquiry to execution.



Position Overview

This is a full-time, sales-focused role responsible for converting inquiries into booked events while delivering a seamless, high-touch client experience.



You will manage the full lifecycle:

Inquiry > Qualification > Proposal > Booking > Planning > 14-Day Handoff



We already have systems, automations, and workflows in place. Your role is to execute within those systems, manage the pipeline, and drive revenue.



This is not an entry-level position.

We are looking for someone with prior experience in catering/hospitality sales, client communication, or event/catering coordination who can take ownership and work independently.



Key Responsibilities

Sales & Booking (Primary Focus)

Manage all inbound catering and event inquiries 
, website, CRM, social)

Qualify leads based on event type, guest count, budget, and timeline

Send proposals, menus, and contracts through CRM

Follow up consistently with warm and cold leads

Convert inquiries into booked events

Upsell enhancements and higher-value packages



Client Experience & Event Planning

Serve as the main point of contact from inquiry through handoff

Guide clients through menu selection and event structure

Answer questions and provide recommendations confidently

Maintain a professional, polished, and on-brand tone

Keep clients engaged and moving toward booking



CRM, Automations & Workflow Management

Manage all leads and communication through Dubsado CRM

Utilize existing workflows, canned
s, and automations

Understand when to use automation vs when to personalize communication

Make minor updates to workflows, templates, and automation triggers as needed

Ensure all leads move through the pipeline with no missed follow-ups

Maintain accurate tags, notes, and statuses



Pipeline & Project Management

Track all leads, bookings, and event progress in 

Move events through each stage of the pipeline

Input booked events into internal templates and manage pre-event tasks

Ensure timelines and internal deliverables are completed



Event Documentation & Prep

Create and manage:

BEOs (Banquet Event Orders)

Event timelines and internal notes

Client-facing menus (Canva)

Ensure all details are finalized prior to handoff



Handoff to Operations

Transition events to the execution team 14 days prior to event

Ensure all details are complete, accurate, and ready for execution



Tools & Systems

Dubsado (CRM, workflows, proposals, contracts)


 (lead tracking and project management)

Canva

Google Workspace

Social Media to scan groups for leads

 Blast



Compensation

$1,100-$1,400 /month base salary based on experience in this industry



Performance-based bonuses after 90 days:

$10 = $0–$2,999 events

$20 = $3,000–$4,999 events

$30 = $5,000+ events

Bonus is paid on signed contracts with deposit received.

We average 5-25 events per month



Who You Are

Sales-driven and confident in closing leads

Strong written and verbal English communication

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Able to manage multiple events and timelines simultaneously

Proactive with follow-ups and pipeline ownership



You also:

Have experience working in a CRM system

Understand workflows and automations

Know when to personalize vs rely on templates

Can think beyond tasks and focus on results



Application Process (Required)

1) Message us with resume & portfolio

2) Send video pre-interview questions by Monday May 11, 10 AM EST

3) You will be sent a zoom link once above is complete 



OPEN INTERVIEW FORMAT

We will be hosting a LIVE OPEN INTERVIEW ZOOM on:

Tuesday, May 12 at 10:00 AM EST

Candidates will enter a waiting room and be brought in individually for approximately 10 minutes to pitch why they are the best fit for this position.

ONLY candidates who complete the pre interview video questions below will receive the Zoom link and be considered for the live interview.



PRE INTERVIEW VIDEO QUESTIONS

1. Introduce yourself and explain your experience in hospitality, catering, event sales, or client management.

2. If a catering lead stopped responding after receiving a proposal, what steps would you take to re-engage and close the client?

3. Walk us through how you would handle this situation:

• A bride is stressed and changing details last minute

• Another client is requesting a proposal revision

• You have 15 unread leads in the CRM

• Two events need BEOs finalized by end of day

How would you prioritize and manage this?



4. Have you worked inside a CRM before? Which systems have you used, and how did you manage follow-ups and lead tracking?

5. Tell us about a time you successfully sold, upsold, or closed a client.

6. How do you balance automation with personalized communication when handling clients?

7. If you noticed leads were not converting, what would you review or improve first?

8. What makes you different from other applicants applying for this role?

9. Confirm your availability during EST business hours and describe your internet/workspace setup.



Final Note

This role is responsible for managing and converting leads into booked events. Please include any relevant experience or results related to sales, client management, or event coordination. This is not an entry-level position.

Candidates MUST have prior experience in catering/hospitality sales, client communication, or event/catering coordination who can take ownership and work independently.

title: AI Video Creator / Editor
description:
NOW HIRING

AI Video Producer / Editor

Faceless AI Short-Form Content — End-to-End Production

Full-time • $2.50 per video • ~6 videos/day



THE ROLE

I run a faceless short-form content operation built on AI video. I write the scripts and hand off the concept — you take it from rawscript to finished, post-ready video. This is a full production role: you own the pipeline from generation to final export and deliver a clean, polished video back to me.



In short: I give you a script. You give me back a finished video that's ready to post. Everything in between is yours.



SCOPE OF WORK

Here's the exact pipeline you'll run for every video, start to finish:



Step 1 — Start from my script

I provide the full script and creative direction. You read it, understand the angle and pacing, and plan the visuals around it before you generate anything.



Step 2 — Generate images in Google Flow



Log into my Google Flow account and generate the images/scenes the script calls for.

Match the visuals to the tone, story, and beats of the script — not random filler.



Step 3 — Quality-check every image before moving on



Review each generation. Weak, off-brand, distorted, or inconsistent images get re-rolled — not passed through.

Nothing moves to video until the images are actually good and ready. This is a filter, not a formality.



Step 4 — Generate the videos



Turn the approved images into video generations.

Same standard as the images — review the output and re-generate anything that looks off, stiff, or broken.



Step 5 — Edit in CapCut



Import everything into CapCut and cut it into a tight, clean edit.

Kill all dead space: no lag, no awkward pauses, no clips that overstay.

Clean, intentional pacing and transitions. The edit should look professional, not stitched together.



Step 6 — Add captions



Add clean, readable, well-timed on-screen captions that match the audio.

Styling stays consistent and on-brand — no sloppy timing or generic auto-caption look.



Step 7 — Swap the voice in ElevenLabs



Replace/generate the voiceover using ElevenLabs to match the voice we're using.

Sync it cleanly to the visuals and captions.



Step 8 — Export and send it to me



Export the finished video in the correct format and send it over, ready to post.

It should need little to no fixing on my end — that's the bar.



TOOLS YOU'LL BE WORKING IN



Google Flow — image + video generation (on my account)

CapCut — editing, cutting, captions

ElevenLabs — AI voiceover



COMPENSATION



Full-time role — $2.50 per video

Target 6 videos/day (~$15/day) with consistent daily volume

Ongoing daily work for the right person

Fast, high-quality operators get more volume over time



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



MUST have prior experience creating AI content with the tools above (Google Flow, CapCut, ElevenLabs).

Fluent English — understand scripts, tone, and direction clearly, and communicate back cleanly.

Genuinely interested in this space — you actually want to learn and understand high-level content, not just click buttons.

Strong eye for quality — you can tell a good generation from a bad one, a clean edit from a lazy one.

Detail-oriented — you catch the small stuff (timing, captions, dead space, sync) without being told twice.

Reliable + fast — you hit deadlines and keep quality high while doing it.

Self-directed — once you know the system, you run it without hand-holding.



THE STANDARD

The finished video should come back clean, tight, and ready to post — good images, good video, no dead space, clean captions, right voice. Consistently hit that bar and you'll get consistent, ongoing work and room to grow into more.



HOW TO APPLY



D
 "Dialed in" first — that's how I know you read the whole post.

Then send a summary of your experience + your portfolio (include any social media pages/accounts you've worked on).



Excited to hear from you all — looking forward to connecting!

About Edge360 / Staff360:  

Edge360 / Staff360 is a trusted Managed Service Provider (MSP) and IT services agency. We help businesses streamline operations, optimize technology, and scale efficiently by providing reliable IT solutions and outsourcing support.



We’re growing fast and looking for motivated professionals who want to be part of a team that drives digital transformation.



Position Overview:  

We’re hiring a Sales & Billing Account Manager who will play a key role in managing client accounts, driving sales opportunities, and ensuring billing accuracy. This role requires someone proactive, detail - oriented, and comfortable working in a fast - paced environment. You’ll be the go - to person for client relationship management, sales coordination, and billing oversight—all while supporting our MSP and IT services projects.



Key Responsibilities:

* Client account management: Serve as the primary point of contact for client accounts, ensuring satisfaction and retention.

* Sales support: Collaborate with sales and technical teams to prepare accurate, competitive quotes and proposals.

* Billing oversight: Handle invoicing, compliance, and account reconciliation to ensure accuracy and timeliness.

* Revenue tracking: Monitor account performance, identify upsell opportunities, and support revenue growth initiatives.

* Vendor coordination: Manage vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and align procurement with client needs.

* Financial collaboration: Work with the accounting team on reconciliations, reporting, audits, and forecasting.

* Process improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline sales and billing workflows for efficiency.



Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience).

* At least 3 years of experience in sales account management or billing operations, preferably in MSP or IT services.

* Proficiency in financial software (QuickBooks, SAP, etc.) and CRM/project management tools (Microsoft Project, Asana, HubSpot, etc.).

* Strong knowledge of billing processes, client account management, and vendor coordination.

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to build strong client relationships.

* High attention to detail, analytical mindset, and problem - solving ability.

* Ability to multitask and prioritize in a deadline - driven environment.

* Familiarity with MSP/IT services industry standards is a plus.



What We Offer:

* Competitive salary with performance - based bonuses

* Opportunities for career growth and professional development

* Flexible remote work options

* A collaborative and supportive team environment

* Exposure to cutting - edge projects in a growing industry

If this sounds like the right fit for you, send us your resume and a short intro video highlighting your relevant experience.



We look forward to welcoming the right candidate to our team!

title: TikTok Ads Manager & Influencer Specialist
description:
We’re Not Hiring Someone to “Post on TikTok.” We’re Hiring Someone Who Can Turn Creators, Content, and Paid Ads Into Growth.



PLEASE DO NOT REPLY DIRECTLY TO THIS POST. IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO APPLY, FOLLOW THE STEPS AT THE END.



Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period in USD, based on experience

Pay Timing: Paid once every 2 weeks. 80 hours per period, agreed upon at hire

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time | Long-term

Team Scope: Supports paid media, influencer marketing, creative, and ecommerce teams across multiple brands



Why This Role Exists

TikTok moves quickly.

Creative gets tired. Trends change. Creators miss deadlines. Campaign performance can shift overnight.



At EcomIgnyte, we work with ecommerce brands that need someone who can manage TikTok advertising while also building a consistent pipeline of creators and UGC content.



We’re hiring a TikTok Ads Manager & Influencer Specialist to launch and optimize TikTok campaigns, find strong creators, coordinate content, manage Spark Ads, and help turn creator videos into paid advertising assets.



This role exists so:

-TikTok campaigns are launched and managed correctly

-Budgets and performance are monitored consistently

-Strong creatives are identified and tested

-Influencer outreach feels personal

-Creator conversations and deadlines stay organized

-Spark Ads permissions and content usage rights are secured

-Performance insights are shared with the creative team

-TikTok becomes a repeatable ecommerce growth channel



This is not about chasing views.

This is about turning TikTok attention into measurable results.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

You will spend most of your time managing TikTok campaigns, reviewing performance, researching creators, coordinating UGC, and keeping campaigns organized.



As a TikTok Ads Manager & Influencer Specialist, you will:

-Build, launch, and optimize campaigns inside TikTok Ads Manager

-Manage budgets, audiences, campaign structure, and creative testing

-Monitor spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and creative performance

-Identify ads that should be scaled, revised, replaced, or paused

-Launch and manage Spark Ads

-Coordinate Spark Ads authorization codes and content usage rights

-Research TikTok creators, UGC creators, affiliates, and influencers

-Identify creators who fit each brand’s audience, product, and voice

-Write personalized outreach and follow-up messages

-Coordinate gifted, paid, affiliate, and UGC partnerships

-Manage creator briefs, deadlines, revisions, and deliverables

-Track creator rates, contact details, permissions, content, and campaign status

-Review creator videos for hooks, pacing, clarity, and paid advertising potential

-Share creative performance insights with designers, editors, and marketing teams

-Organize tasks, updates, and deadlines inside ClickUp

-Prepare clear weekly performance and creator reports



You are not expected to create every TikTok video yourself.



You are expected to help make sure TikTok activity is:

-Organized

-Creative-led

-Performance-focused

-On-brand

-Properly tracked

-Moving forward



This Role Is for Someone Who

-Has hands-on experience with TikTok Ads Manager

-Understands ecommerce performance marketing

-Can review campaign data and explain what it means

-Understands that TikTok performance depends heavily on creative

-Can identify strong hooks, angles, creators, and video formats

-Is comfortable contacting creators they have never met

-Can write outreach that sounds natural instead of automated

-Understands Spark Ads and creator permissions

-Can manage multiple campaigns, creators, and deadlines

-Follows up consistently

-Communicates problems before they become larger issues

-Can follow brand and creative direction without ego

-Keeps ClickUp and reporting systems updated



Experience that helps:

-TikTok Ads Manager

-TikTok Shop

-Spark Ads

-TikTok Pixel and event tracking

-Influencer outreach

-UGC coordination

-Affiliate recruitment

-Ecommerce marketing

-Creative testing

-Shopify

-ClickUp

-Google Sheets or reporting dashboards



You do not need to be a famous TikTok creator.

You do need:

-Strong marketing judgment

-Good communication instincts

-Analytical thinking

-Attention to detail

-Strong organizational habits

-The discipline to follow through



How You’ll Work With the Team

-Data Team provides reporting, performance insights, and audience direction. You use that information to make better campaign and creator decisions.

-Creative Team develops videos, graphics, and campaign concepts. You provide creative feedback, performance insights, and creator content.

-Ads Team supports TikTok Pixel, events, and attribution. You identify and communicate tracking concerns.

You are not managing TikTok in isolation.



You are part of a connected system built to help ecommerce brands test better creative, manage spend responsibly, and grow through paid media and creator partnerships.



Why You’ll Like Working Here

-Clear expectations and workflows

-Variety across multiple ecommerce brands

-Structured campaign and creator systems

-Opportunities to build real creator relationships

-Access to creative and data support

-Leadership that values judgment and accountability

-Long-term role with growth opportunities



We do not reward activity for the sake of activity.

We reward useful analysis, organized execution, and consistent follow-through.

To be considered, you must complete all the steps below.

The Google Form is your online interview.

Why this role is a good fit

Your answers matter more than perfect formatting.



Step 4: Live Video Interview, Camera On

I personally review every candidate who completes the steps above and will reach out directly to those who feel like the right fit.



If this role speaks to you, good.

That means you may be the kind of person we’re looking for.



Bring your best.

title: Experienced Appointment Setter | Cold Caller | B2B
description:

We are seeking a motivated and confident appointment setter who enjoys speaking with business owners, making outbound calls, and setting qualified meetings for our sales team.



This is a long-term opportunity with strong income potential for the right person.



## Compensation



* Base Salary: **$600-$800 USD/month** (based on experience and performance)

* Performance Bonuses Available

* Recurring Commission Opportunity



Top performers have the potential to significantly increase their monthly earnings through commissions and long-term growth within the company.



## Responsibilities



* Make outbound calls to small and medium-sized businesses in the United States

* Speak directly with business owners and decision-makers

* Qualify prospects and identify interest in our services

* Schedule appointments on our team's calendar

* Update CRM notes and maintain organized records

* Conduct follow-up calls when necessary

* CRM and appointment-setting systems

* Excellent English communication skills

* Confident speaking voice with clear pronunciation

* Previous appointment setting, cold calling, or sales experience preferred

* Experience in B2B sales, merchant services, real estate, insurance, SaaS, solar, or similar industries is a plus but not required

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

* Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet work environment

* Positive attitude and willingness to learn



## Ideal Candidate



You are:



* Energetic and self-motivated

* Comfortable handling objections

* Persistent and resilient

* Goal-oriented and competitive

* Excited about earning commissions in addition to your base pay



## Application Instructions (Please Read Carefully)



Attention to detail is extremely important in this role. To help us identify candidates who follow instructions, please complete the following steps:



### Step 1:



Submit your resume.



### Step 2:

title: Warm & Cold Lead Handler / Appointment Setter — UK Hours, Fluent English, Experienced Only
description:
About us

- HDC Consultancy is a UK digital agency. We build websites and run marketing for businesses across the UK, and we handle leads for our own brands as well as our clients'. That means real leads coming in daily, across several different businesses, that need someone sharp on the phone to pick them up fast and turn them into booked appointments.



The role

- You are the first voice a lead hears. When an enquiry lands, you call it. Fast. You qualify them, you follow the script and instructions for that business, and you either book them in or move them to the next step. You then follow up by phone and
 until you get an answer either way.

- You will also work warm and cold lists: chasing older leads, re-engaging people who went quiet, and outbound calling where we ask you to.

- This is not a role where leads sit in a spreadsheet until tomorrow. Speed is the whole job.



What you will do

- Call every new lead within 10 minutes of it landing (during working hours). This is the single most important rule of the role.

- Qualify leads against the criteria we give you for that business

- Book appointments into our calendars, or progress the lead to the agreed next step

- Follow up by phone and
 on a set cadence until the lead converts or clearly says no

- Work across multiple businesses and services, switching tone and script depending on which brand you are calling as

- Log every call, outcome and next action in Airtable. If it is not in the CRM, it did not happen

- Keep the pipeline clean and chase what needs chasing

- Attend a short weekly check-in on Microsoft Teams and report on your numbers



You must have

- Fluent spoken and written English. You will be speaking to UK business owners and members of the public every day. This is non-negotiable and we will test it.

- Minimum 1 year experience in calls or sales (appointment setting, inbound/outbound sales, telesales, SDR, call centre). We are not training a beginner.

- Confidence handling both warm enquiries and cold calls, and comfort handling rejection

- The ability to pick up a new product, service or business quickly and sound like you know it

- Discipline to follow instructions and a proven process exactly, rather than improvising

- Strong written English for follow-up
s

- Experience with a CRM. Airtable is a big plus. Comfortable with Microsoft Teams.

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to call from, a decent headset, and a backup internet connection or power so a brownout does not cost us a day of leads



Nice to have

- Experience calling UK or other Western markets

- Experience selling or setting appointments for services (web, marketing, legal, finance, trades)

- Experience working across multiple brands or clients at once



Hours

- Fully remote

- UK business hours (this is essential, our leads are UK based)

- Some weekend calling required. Leads come in at weekends and they are the easiest to win because nobody else calls them back. This will be on an agreed rota, not every weekend, all day.

- Part-time to full-time depending on volume and how you perform



Compensation

- A bonus per appointment booked and attended, and a bonus when a lead closes. If you are good at this you will earn well above the base.

- Long-term role. We are growing and there is room to take on more responsibility and more of the pipeline.



How we will measure you

Simple, and you will always know where you stand:

- Speed to first call (target: under 10 minutes)

- Contact rate

- Appointments booked

- Appointments that actually show up

- Leads closed



To apply

Applications that ignore these steps will not be read.

- Start your message with the word TENMINUTES so I know you actually read this.

- Attach a 1 to 2 minute voice recording or short video of yourself introducing yourself in English, and telling me about one lead or sale you personally closed and how you did it.

- Tell me how many years you have been making calls, what you were selling, and roughly how many calls a day you were making.

- Tell me honestly how you handle it when someone says "I'm not interested" in the first ten seconds.

- Confirm you can work UK hours and are okay with some weekend calling.

title: Amazon Account Manager
description:
Full-Time | Remote | 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM PST (Monday–Friday)



We're looking for an experienced Amazon Account Manager to help grow our flagship Amazon brand.



In this role, you'll work directly with the founder and collaborate with our PPC Manager, Finance/Inventory VA, TikTok Affiliate Manager, and Operations team. You'll begin by learning our current systems and strategies before taking ownership of our Amazon operations.



This is a long-term opportunity with room for growth in a collaborative, performance-driven company where your ideas and initiative are valued.



What You'll Do

- Manage the day-to-day operations of our Amazon Seller Central account.

- Maintain and optimize product listings, including titles, bullets, images, A+ Content, and backend keywords.

- Monitor account health and proactively resolve issues before they become larger problems.

- Manage customer service, returns, reviews, reimbursements, and Amazon support cases.

- Create, track, and reconcile FBA shipments.

- Run Amazon promotions, coupons, and deals according to our promotional calendar.

- Analyze sales, traffic, and listing performance to identify opportunities for growth.

- Plan and execute A/B tests to improve conversion rates and listing performance.

- Monitor competitor activity and marketplace trends.

- Prepare a weekly performance report highlighting sales, account health, conversion metrics, and opportunities.

- Support new Amazon brands with listing setup and ongoing maintenance as they're launched.

- Work closely with the PPC Manager by sharing keyword insights, creative improvements, and testing results.



We're looking for someone who has:

- At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

- Experience managing multiple SKUs and preferably multiple Amazon brands.

- Experience with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Brand Analytics.

- Hands-on experience creating FBA shipments, reconciling inventory, and filing reimbursement claims.

- Experience running structured Amazon listing A/B tests (Amazon Manage Your Experiments or similar).

- A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze results and continuously improve performance.

- Advanced Google Sheets or Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and complex formulas.

- A working knowledge of inventory forecasting and reorder point calculations.

- The ability to build organized weekly reports without requiring detailed templates.

- Excellent written English for customer service and Amazon case communication.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.



Nice to Have

- Familiarity with Amazon PPC (you won't manage campaigns, but you'll collaborate closely with our PPC Manager).

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to improve workflows and reporting.

- Experience with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon software.

- Experience with TikTok Shop Seller Central.

- Experience working with regulated or compliance-sensitive products.

- Experience working in a small, founder-led company where taking ownership is expected.



What Success Looks Like:



Weeks 1–2

Learn our current Amazon workflows by shadowing the founder.

Become familiar with our promotional calendar, listing strategy, and internal processes.



By Week 3

Deliver your first weekly performance report.



By Week 6

Produce consistent weekly reports.

Launch your first structured A/B test with documented results and recommendations.



By Day 90

Independently manage the flagship Amazon account.

Proactively identify and resolve issues before they become escalations.

Successfully support newly launched brands alongside flagship operations.



What This Role Doesn't Include?

- Managing PPC campaigns (handled by our dedicated PPC Manager).

- Negotiating with suppliers.

- Placing purchase orders.

- Making final pricing or product development decisions.



Why Join Us?

- Work directly with the founder and make a meaningful impact.

- Long-term position with opportunities for professional growth.

- Supportive, collaborative remote team.

- A company that values ownership, initiative, and continuous improvement.



Application Questions



To help us better understand your experience, please answer the following questions when you apply:

1. Can you commit to working full-time, 6:30 AM–3:00 PM PST, Monday–Friday?

2. Describe your internet speed and reliability. What backup plan do you have if your power or internet goes down during work hours?

3. How many ASINs or SKUs have you managed simultaneously, and across how many Amazon brands or Seller Central accounts?

4. List the Amazon Seller Central tasks you've personally handled. Please be as specific as possible.

5. Have you managed Amazon Brand Registry and A+ Content? Please describe one example.

6. Have you filed Amazon FBA reimbursement claims? Approximately how many, and what were the results?

7. Describe an A/B test you've run on an Amazon listing. What was your hypothesis, and what did you learn?

8. Rate your experience (1–10) in the following areas:

    - Google Sheets / Excel

    - Amazon Seller Central

    - Amazon Brand Analytics

    - Amazon A+ Content

    - Amazon Manage Your Experiments (or similar)

    - Canva, Photoshop, or similar design tools



9. Share three examples that demonstrate your attention to detail in Amazon-related work.

10. Tell us about a time you identified and solved an issue before anyone else noticed it.

11. How long were you in your most recent relevant role, and why did you leave?

12. What's the biggest challenge you've faced managing an Amazon account, and how did you overcome it?

13. What are your long-term career goals?

14. A customer leaves a 1-star review saying their item arrived damaged. Please write the exact response you would post.



Please attach your resume and include a link to your LinkedIn profile.

title: TikTok Marketplace Officer
description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand expanding aggressively on TikTok Shop. We operate multiple product categories and brand shops, and we're looking for one sharp, hands-on TikTok Shop Marketplace Manager who can own the entire channel — from product listings and promotions to affiliate relationships and creator campaigns. If you know TikTok Shop inside and out and want real ownership of a growing program, this role is for you.



Role Overview

This is a single, end-to-end ownership role. You will be responsible for two interconnected pillars:



1. TikTok Shop Operations  —  Product listings, shop management, promotions, GMV Max campaigns, and shop growth.

2. Affiliate & Creator Management  —  Finding, onboarding, managing, and growing affiliates and creator partnerships that drive real GMV.



You will report directly to the founder and run both pillars independently with ongoing guidance. This is not a task-taker role — we need someone proactive and commercial who takes ownership of results.



Key Responsibilities

Pillar 1: TikTok Shop Operations

• Upload and optimize product listings across all brand shops — titles, descriptions, images, and product content optimized for conversion.

• Organize products correctly across different shops and brand accounts.

• Create and manage company posts and promotional content on TikTok accounts.

• Build and execute posting plans for brand TikTok accounts.

• Set up, launch, and monitor GMV Max campaigns to drive product visibility and sales.

• Monitor shop performance (traffic, conversion, sales) and proactively recommend improvements.

• Manage promotions, discounts, and TikTok Shop growth tools.

• Provide regular reporting, updates, and growth recommendations to the founder.



Pillar 2: Affiliate & Creator Management

• Review and vet affiliate applications for free product samples; assess audience fit, content quality, and performance history.

• Handle outreach and communication with affiliates and creators via
 tools (Euka) and DMs — set up global messages, segment by niche or performance tier, and keep affiliates engaged.

• Identify high-potential creators and negotiate monthly retainers ($300–$1,500) for 8–12 videos/month plus commission on sales.

• Draft offers, track deliverables, and optimise retainer arrangements for ROI.

• Manage our affiliate community (50+ members), run monthly contests rewarding top GMV generators and video posters with prizes.

• Use tools like Refunnel to track submissions, attribute sales, and maintain leaderboards.

• Coordinate sample shipments and track creator and affiliate activity end-to-end.

• Monitor creator performance, affiliate GMV, and engagement metrics — report weekly insights.

• Support expansion of affiliates onto Amazon attribution and Refersion for multi-channel growth.



Tools You'll Use

Comfort with the following tools is expected or quickly learnable:



• TikTok Shop Seller Center (listings, campaigns, GMV Max)

• Euka —
 automation and affiliate communications

• Refunnel — UGC tracking, sales attribution, leaderboards

• Canva — content briefs and basic creative assets

• Google Sheets — reporting, GMV tracking, performance dashboards

• Community management platform (
 or similar) for affiliate community



What We're Looking For

Required Experience

• Proven, hands-on experience managing live TikTok Shop accounts — not theoretical knowledge.

• Experience listing products into TikTok Shop and managing shop operations end-to-end.

• Track record in affiliate marketing, influencer management, or creator partnerships — with real GMV results to show.

• Good understanding of GMV Max and TikTok Shop growth levers.

• Strong e-commerce background — you understand conversion, not just content.



Skills & Traits

• Excellent written English for
s, DMs, and community management.

• Strong negotiation skills for creator retainers and partnership terms.

• Analytical mindset — comfortable with GMV, engagement rates, conversion metrics, and ROI.

• Highly organized with sharp attention to detail across multiple shops, brands, and creator relationships simultaneously.

• Proactive and commercial — you find ways to move things forward without being told.

• People person who builds genuine relationships with creators and affiliates.

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced remote environment.



Practical Requirements

• Full-time availability during US Pacific Time hours (6:30AM – 3:30 PM PST, Monday–Friday).

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace.

• Based in the Philippines or Pakistan (preferred for time zone alignment and platform familiarity).

• Available to start immediately following a short-paid test task.



How to Apply

Start your application with the phrase TIKTOK GROWTH at the top so we know you've read this carefully.



Then answer all of the following questions in your application:



1. What TikTok Shop accounts or brands have you worked on?

2. What exactly did you do for those accounts? (Be specific — operations, affiliates, content, campaigns?)

3. Have you listed products into TikTok Shop yourself? Walk us through your process.

4. What affiliate campaigns have you run that drove real sales? What were the results?

5. What experience do you have with creators and influencers? How do you find the right ones?

6. Have you used GMV Max before? If yes, explain how and what results you achieved.

7. Have you worked with multiple shops or multiple brands simultaneously? How did you manage it?

8. How would you approach growing a new or underdeveloped TikTok Shop account from scratch?

9. Please send examples, screenshots, or case studies of your past TikTok Shop work.

10. What is your availability per week, and when can you start?





We're building something big. If you can own TikTok Shop end-to-end, we want to hear from you.
