The starting salary will be $750 USD per month, with the opportunity for an annual raise based on performance. There will also be a bonus at the end of your first year and at the end of each subsequent year you’re with the company. The bonus amount will also depend on performance.



After 6 months, you will receive 5 days of paid vacation time that you may use as you wish, including for vacation and illness. Each following year on that date, your 5 vacation days will renew. You will receive Christmas and New Year's Day off as paid days that will not count toward your 5 days. If either of those holidays falls on a weekend, you will be given a paid day off during the week to make up for it.



You may not take off between Black Friday (late November) and Christmas (Dec. 25), or during April and May. These are our busiest times of the year, and we need someone we can depend upon during these times.



We also provide a 13th check in December.



We provide salaries through Wise on or before the 18th of each month.





About 
:



We’re a small business located in the midwestern US that specializes in personalized plaques, awards, signs, and memorials. We’re a small company with around 25 employees. 5 of those employees work remotely from the Philippines, and about 10 are remote but local in case we need them in the office. The rest are in our office full-time.



We work directly with consumers rather than only business-to-business. Our store is hosted on Shopify, but we also work on Amazon and Etsy. The majority of our customers are in the US, but we offer select international shipping as well. Everything will be done in American English (AmE).

title: Content Creator & Copywriter
description:
The Role 



Virtue Health is building a content engine in a space that has almost none, and you are the person who will run it. As our Content Creator and Copywriter, you own the words and the aesthetics across every channel we operate: social media,
 campaigns, and broader marketing initiatives. We will give you context, information, and direction, and then we expect you to take it and run. You do not wait to be handed a finished brief. You absorb what we know about our audience, our product, and our message and you turn it into content that cuts through. 



 



In your first 90 days, you will have refreshed our LinkedIn presence, launched a consistent publishing cadence, written and deployed at least two
 campaigns, and shown us that you can produce strong content independently with minimal back-and-forth. By day 90, our marketing output will look, sound, and perform like a brand that means business. 



What You’ll Do 



You’ll hit the ground running. Here’s what that looks like: 



 



Create and publish original content across LinkedIn, Instagram, and any other channels we operate, maintaining a consistent cadence and a visual and copy identity that is unmistakably Virtue Health 



Write copy for
 marketing campaigns from subject lines to full sequences, including nurture
s, adviser-facing communications, campaign launches, and re-engagement flows 



Produce campaign copy and creative assets for broader marketing initiatives: landing pages, promotional announcements, event materials, sales enablement content, and anything else the business needs 



Work independently to develop content ideas and angles from raw information: we will point you at a topic, a product update, or an industry trend, and you will figure out how to make it compelling and relevant to our audience without needing us to pre-chew it for you 



Design or direct the visual assets that accompany your content, including graphics, carousels, cover images, and short-form video edits, using tools like Canva, Adobe Express, or equivalent 



Develop and maintain Virtue Health’s content identity across formats: copy tone, visual language, and platform-specific style so every piece we publish feels intentional and consistent 



Repurpose content intelligently across formats: a podcast takeaway becomes a LinkedIn carousel, a campaign becomes a newsletter, a client result becomes a story worth telling 



Track performance across channels and campaigns and use real data to d
 what to keep, cut, and test next 



What You Bring 



Must-Haves 



3+ years of hands-on content creation and copywriting experience, with a portfolio that shows both strong writing and real aesthetic sensibility across social and
 formats 



Proven copywriting chops across multiple formats: social posts,
 subject lines and body copy, campaign copy, and short-form marketing content. Your writing is clear, punchy, and built for the platform it lives on 



The ability to take a topic or a set of information and produce strong content independently without needing a fully formed brief. You are a self-starter who figures things out, not someone who waits to be told exactly what to write 



Strong visual instincts and proficiency with design tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or equivalent: things you make look polished and deliberate 



Experience writing for a B2B audience: you understand that tone, depth, and format look very different when you are talking to a benefits broker versus a consumer 



Comfortable with basic video editing for short-form content: reels, clips, talking-head cuts, on-screen captions 



Highly self-managed with strong ownership of deadlines: you run your own publishing calendar and you do not need to be chased 



 



Great to Have 



Experience creating content in healthcare, employee benefits, insurance, or financial services, or a demonstrable ability to learn a complex industry fast and write about it with confidence 



Experience writing
 marketing sequences in a platform such as HubSpot, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar 



Familiarity with LinkedIn content strategy for B2B brands, including what formats and angles drive organic engagement 



Experience ghostwriting thought leadership content for executives or managing a personal brand alongside a company presence 



You’re a Fit If You… 



Thrive in a fast-paced environment and treat ambiguity as an opportunity, not a roadblock. 



Hold yourself to a high standard and then raise it. 



Own your results. No excuses, no hand-holding, just solutions. 



Operate with integrity in everything you do, even when no one is watching. 



Show up consistently, follow through on every commitment, and do it well. 



Push yourself and the people around you to be better and mean it. 



Take feedback as fuel, not criticism. You’re always learning. 



Get genuinely energized by the challenge of making a complex, unsexy industry compelling, and you see that constraint as a creative opportunity, not an excuse for boring content.

title: DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist - PH based
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands. 



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire -  immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: Growth & Operations Right-Hand at Fantum Growth Co.
description:
Hey, I'm Austin.



Here's an intro the position: 



I run Fantum Growth Co. We're a small growth team that partners with financial advisors (and a couple of other businesses) to actually grow them. Most agencies build you a nice website and disappear. We build the engine and stay in the weeds with our clients month after month.



Here's the honest reason this role exists. Right now almost everything runs through me. I'm on every call, I set the strategy, I write, I build, I sell, and then I hand things off. That's the thing capping us. I don't need another set of hands to run a checklist, Sam, our project manager already does that beautifully and keeps the scheduled machine going. What I need is someone who sees what needs to happen before I say it, grabs it, and either does it themselves or hands it to Sam. Someone who makes me a little less necessary in the day to day so I can focus on the parts only I can do.



If you're the kind of person who reads a situation and starts moving without waiting to be told, keep reading. If you need a detailed task list to feel comfortable, this probably isn't the one.



What you'd actually own



The heart of it is growth. You'd own filling the pipeline, for our clients and for Fantum itself:



Researching and building target lists (centers of influence, venues, podcasts, joint-event partners) around each client's niche

Writing personalized outreach that sounds like a human, sending it at real volume, and working the replies

Actually booking the placements, appearances, and workbook drops, then following up relentlessly so nobody goes cold

Owning the numbers and reporting them: outreach sent, reply and acceptance rate, placements, bookings



You'd also be my right hand in the day to day:



- Coming to client calls with me, catching what needs to get done, and assigning it to yourself or Sam right there and leveraging our internal app to keep things

- Managing a chunk of the
 work, including building
s in our
 builder for Creations of Christ, our Christ-centered art brand

- Generating images with AI (ChatGPT and others) when we need them

- Running Shopify tasks for Creations and keeping the store and orders in good shape

- Staying on top of follow-ups, since that's the thing that quietly kills deals the second it slips



You won't do it alone. Sam owns the scheduled execution and content (Opus clips, AI-drafted copy, posting). I own the strategy, the creative direction, and the sales. You're the person in the middle who makes sure the important things happen and don't sit waiting on me.



The one thing I care about most is proactivity.



I'll say this plainly because it matters more than any skill on the list. I'm looking for someone who moves first. Who notices a client hasn't heard from us in a week and drafts the follow-up before I ask. Who sees a list of COIs and starts researching instead of waiting for the green light. Who comes to a call and leaves with a plan instead of a question. Low effort always beats none, and the people who win here are the ones who just start.



I have ADHD, so I've actually built a whole system for this. We run our own tool that turns call transcripts into tasks and routes them to the right person. You'd live in that system every day, and it makes being proactive easier, not harder. But the system doesn't create the drive. That part has to be you.



Skills that matter



Must have:

- Genuinely proactive. This is the whole job. You take an ambiguous "here's what we're trying to do" and you run with it.

- Really good with AI. You use it like a co-worker to research, draft, summarize, and move three times faster than a normal hire. - We're an AI-first team and you'll live in the tools.

- Strong, human writing. Outreach and
s that sound like a real person, not a template.

- Follow-through and organization. You close loops. Things don't fall through with you.

- Comfortable talking to professionals. You'll be representing our advisors to their centers of influence, so warmth and judgment matter.



Nice to have, or willing to learn fast:

- GoHighLevel (pipelines, automations, follow-up flows)

- Shopify and
 builders like Klaviyo

- Any outreach, SDR, or growth background

- A decent eye for design and images



Honestly, the tool skills are teachable in about a week with AI. The proactivity and the judgment are not. So if you don't know GoHighLevel yet but you're the type who figures things out and never waits to be told, apply anyway.



What great looks like

- In the first month, you're in the calls, you know our clients, and things are already getting picked up without me assigning them. By 90 days, you own the outreach engine for at least one client end to end, the numbers are actually moving, and I've stopped being the bottleneck in the day to day. The real win is simple. I stop being the only person who can see what needs to happen next.



A little about us

- We're small on purpose. Few clients, deep partnerships, work from anywhere. I've got a wife and a baby, and the freedom to build this from anywhere is the whole point of how it's shaped, so I care a lot about working with people I genuinely like. If you're proactive, curious, good with AI, and you want to help build something instead of just clocking tasks, I'd love to talk.



To apply complete the test project described in this document: 





We look forward to hearing from you!

Solid Rock Consulting (SRC) helps organizations get the most out of their Workforce Management (WFM) platforms through hands-on configuration and training as part of our Professional Services offering. Clients bring us their WFM systems — Verint, Genesys, NICE — and we make sure the platform is configured correctly and the client's own team knows how to fully use it.



We're hiring a WFM System Administrator who is a genuine multi-platform expert. This is a client-facing configuration and training role: you'll go into a client's environment, configure their WFM system to match how they actually operate, and train their team to run it confidently on their own.

Own Client Engagements

Support Practice Growth

• Contribute configuration and training best practices back into SRC's internal methodology and materials



What You'll Bring

Required

This role rewards deep technical mastery paired with the ability to teach: someone who not only configures a system correctly but can explain why it's set up that way in terms a client's team can actually use. The best people in this role treat every engagement as a chance to leave a client more self-sufficient than they found them.

title: Warm Inbound Sales VA, No Cold Calling, Part-Time (US Textbook Supplier)
description:
No cold calling. No dialing lists. No rejection grind.



Buyers contact us already wanting to buy textbooks. Most of those orders die because nobody follows up. You are the person who fixes that.



CyberstarIT LLC, a United States company, is hiring this seat for a client that wholesales textbooks to K-12 schools across the US. You work day to day with that client's team. CyberstarIT contracts you and pays you directly, every week.



THE JOB



A buyer messages or calls asking about a title, an edition, or a bulk price. You ask the questions that actually matter before quoting: which edition, what grade level, how many copies, when they need them, who signs off, what budget they are working to. You send a clear quote. You follow up until you get a yes or a no. You close the order and hand it cleanly to fulfillment.



You will be talking to school administrators, department heads, secretaries and procurement staff. They are busy and they are spending someone else's money. You have to sound like a professional they are glad they called.



One thing you should know before applying: this business does most of its year between June and September. You are joining in the middle of the busiest stretch. There is real work waiting on day one.



WHAT COMES WITH THE SEAT



Warm inbound only. You never build a list, buy data, or hunt for leads.

One client, one product line. You learn it properly instead of juggling five accounts.

Paid weekly by CyberstarIT LLC, a US company, on a fixed day.

20 hours a week, deliberately, so it fits alongside whatever else you are running.

We hire for the long term and would rather fill this seat once.



WHO THIS IS FOR



You have spent real years on the phone with buyers. You are comfortable asking someone how much they can spend and when they can d
, without sounding pushy. You keep a follow-up list and you actually work it.



REQUIRED



Genuine inside sales, inbound sales, or account management experience. Order-taking alone is not enough. We need someone who asks questions and closes.

Excellent spoken English. This role is live conversations, not
 only.

Disciplined follow-up. You track every open quote and you chase it.

Available during US Pacific business hours, roughly 8am to 5pm Pacific. Confirm in your application which hours in that window you can genuinely commit to.



PAY



$9 to $14 per hour to start, based on how much of this you have clearly already done. Most people we bring in at the top of that range have five or more years of real inside sales behind them.



At 20 hours a week that is roughly $780 to $1,215 per month.



General VA work on this site pays $5 to $9 an hour. This is a specialist seat and it pays like one.



HOW TO APPLY



One seat. Applications close Thursday 23 July, 11:59pm Manila time.



Put SYLLABUS in your subject line. Applications without it are not read.



Then answer these three questions. Keep it short. Specific beats polished.



1. Pick one deal you personally closed where the buyer was not sure at first. What were you selling?

2. What was their objection?

3. What did you say next, and what changed their mind?



Also tell me which hours in the 8am to 5pm Pacific window you can commit to.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



There is no video to record and nothing to upload. If your application is strong, we send you a link to book a five minute call. That call opens with a sales scenario you have not seen, and you answer it live, out loud. That is the whole test. If you are good on the phone it is the easiest five minutes of your week. If you are not, this role will not work out for either of us.



Every application that includes the keyword and answers the three questions gets a straight yes or a no from us by Friday 24 July. We do not ghost people.

title: Meta Media Buyer
description:
NOTE: Please do not apply if you primarily have lead gen experience.



About Lucyd



Lucyd is a performance marketing and growth agency helping ambitious wellness brands scale through acquisition, retention, creative strategy, and conversion optimization.



We specialize in building scalable growth systems for brands operating in policy-constrained wellness, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (including GLP-1s and research peptides), supplements, and functional wellness products.



We are more than an agency executing individual services. We operate as integrated growth partners embedded in our clients’ businesses, helping them solve challenges across the entire customer journey—from customer acquisition and retention to creative, websites, and conversion optimization.



Our team moves quickly, communicates transparently, and operates with a high level of ownership and accountability. We care deeply about outcomes, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and long-term client partnerships.



---



Why This Role Exists



The Media Buyer, Paid Social is responsible for bringing growth strategies to life through exceptional execution on Meta.



Working closely with a Growth Strategist, you’ll build, launch, optimize, and scale paid social campaigns that drive profitable growth for our clients. You’ll combine strong platform expertise with analytical thinking to make informed optimization decisions, uncover opportunities through data, and continuously improve campaign performance.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys executing at a high level, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in operational excellence.



---



Working in Complex Advertising Environments



Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward.



Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products.



Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly.



---



What You’ll Own



Campaign Execution & Optimization



- Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across a portfolio of DTC ecommerce clients.

- Execute testing plans across audiences, creatives, placements, budgets, and campaign structures.

- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimization decisions that improve efficiency and profitability.

- Manage campaign budgets and pacing while maintaining alignment with client performance goals.

- Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform-related challenges.



Performance Analysis



- Analyze campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager and supporting analytics platforms.

- Identify trends across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and funnel performance.

- Understand *why* creative is succeeding or underperforming, using performance data to generate actionable insights.

- Monitor key performance metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and other leading indicators.

- Prepare performance updates and reporting for internal stakeholders and client-facing meetings.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



- Partner closely with Growth Strategists to execute paid media strategies across assigned accounts.

- Collaborate with Creative teams by providing data-backed recommendations for new concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative testing opportunities.

- Contribute ideas during creative strategy discussions while helping ensure creative testing aligns with account priorities.

- Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding campaign performance, blockers, and opportunities.

- Participate in client calls as needed and communicate confidently in written client updates.



---



What Success Looks Like



Successful Media Buyers consistently:



- Execute campaigns accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail.

- Achieve client MER, aMER, CAC and bCAC goals through disciplined optimization and testing.

- Move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality.

- Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams.

- Complete work reliably, follow established processes, and demonstrate strong operational excellence.

- Use data to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve performance over time.



---



What You Bring to the Table



Required



- 3+ years of experience managing Meta advertising for DTC ecommerce brands.

- Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

- Experience managing six-figure monthly Meta advertising budgets.

- Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, audience strategy, and optimization best practices.

- Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce ecommerce brands.

- Ability to analyze creative performance and identify the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong written communication skills and comfort participating in client meetings when needed.

- Experience working successfully in a remote environment.

- Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.



Preferred



- Experience working with third-party attribution platforms such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar.

- Experience advertising within policy-constrained wellness industries, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (GLP-1s, peptides), supplements, and functional wellness.

- Experience managing campaigns on TikTok, X, or Snapchat.

- Familiarity with GA4 and ecommerce analytics.

- Experience collaborating closely with creative teams on performance marketing initiatives.



---



Who Thrives at Lucyd



Successful Paid Social Media Buyers at Lucyd are proactive, detail-oriented operators who enjoy turning strategy into execution.



They are analytical, adaptable, and naturally curious about what drives performance. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. They thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy solving complex problems with data, and embrace continuous learning as advertising platforms evolve.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Must work US East Coast morning hours. 



About the Role

Cojoy RevGen builds unified revenue engines for high-growth B2B companies. We are looking for a Marketing Assistant who can own the execution layer of our marketing and outbound motion, someone who takes clear frameworks and runs with them without needing to be managed step by step.

This is not a strategy role. It is a precision execution role. You will be responsible for keeping our content pipeline moving, our outbound sequences running, our website updated, and our lead generation activity organized and measurable. If you are someone who takes pride in doing things right the first time and finds satisfaction in clean, well-structured work, this role is built for you.



Core Responsibilities

Website Operations and Technical SEO

You will stage long-form content updates in HubSpot, set up Schema markup on core service pages, embed lead capture assets, and manage internal linking to align with search intent. Every page element you touch should be publication-ready before it goes to review.



Social Distribution and
 Outbound

You will manage our multi-channel content pipeline, translating executive notes and source material into drafted social posts and outbound
 sequences, structuring them for final approval before scheduling. Distribution runs on SocialChamp and must follow a consistent cadence without gaps.



Lead Generation and Prospecting Support

You will support our outbound lead generation effort end to end. This includes researching and building targeted prospect lists based on our ideal client profile (funded B2B companies, CEO or COO contacts, Series B and beyond), verifying contact data for accuracy, loading contacts into HubSpot with clean field mapping, and tracking outreach activity so nothing falls through the cracks. You will not be writing the strategy. You will be executing it with precision and keeping the pipeline full.



Project and Campaign Organization

You will keep all active campaigns, content calendars, task assignments, and execution deadlines updated inside ClickUp. Deadlines do not slip because the system is not maintained. That maintenance is your responsibility.



Mandatory Tool Requirements

• HubSpot: Native comfort uploading blog content, managing contact records, building and updating lead forms, and executing web formatting tasks

• ClickUp: Strong skill managing task dependencies, structuring subtasks, and keeping project sprints on track

• SocialChamp: Familiarity scheduling and managing multi-platform content queues

• LinkedIn and prospecting tools: Comfort using LinkedIn, 
, or similar tools to research and build targeted B2B prospect lists



Operating Standards

Flawless Written English is non-negotiable. Every heading, caption,
 sequence, metadata snippet, and social post you stage must be written in complete, grammatically correct, professional sentences. We have a strict zero-fragment policy across all public-facing platforms.



Accuracy over speed. We would rather receive something right on the second pass than something sloppy on the first. Every contact record you load, every link you set, and every sequence you stage reflects on the brand.

Proactive communication. If something is unclear, ask before you start, not after you have spent two hours going in the wrong direction. One good clarifying question at the beginning saves everyone time.

description:

Profile: A broad, deeply capable engineer comfortable across the full stack, from Salesforce front-end and Apex through to AWS-hosted Java services, web routing and document-processing pipelines. Acts as technical anchor for the platform.





Role Overview

Own and scale the Simploud platform end-to-end. Lead the Salesforce development lifecycle, manage AWS cloud infrastructure, and handle complex enterprise integrations and document-processing workflows. This person is the senior technical authority who can make architecture decisions and mentor the second developer.

•Develop, customize and maintain core platform features using Salesforce Aura, LWC and Apex.

•Architect and implement robust, secure API integrations both from and to Salesforce.

•Solid understanding of security best practices across cloud, application and integration layers.

•Proficiency with Git/GitHub workflows (branching, PRs, code review, CI basics).

•Ownership mindset: able to take charge of projects and deliver results with minimal supervision.

•Communicative, expressive and highly articulate in English (written and spoken).

Advantageous (Nice-to-Have)

•Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II).

•Experience in regulated / quality-driven software environments (e.g. life sciences, GxP, ISO) and disciplined change control.

•CI/CD tooling for Salesforce (e.g. SFDX, Gearset, Copado) and infrastructure scripting."

title: Buyer
description:
Disclaimer: This is a fully remote position for a company based in the United States. The schedule is 12:00pm - 8:00pm EDT / 12:00am - 8:00am PHT.



Position Summary

The Buyer is responsible for supporting the procurement and inventory replenishment activities necessary to meet customer demand and maintain healthy inventory levels. This role works closely with Sales, Warehouse, Accounting, and Supplier Partners to ensure products are purchased accurately, delivered on time, and managed efficiently throughout the supply chain.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to develop a career in supply chain, purchasing, and inventory management. Success in this role is measured by the ability to maintain accurate purchasing records, proactively manage supplier commitments, support inventory availability, and contribute to a positive customer experience.

________________________________________

Performance Objectives

Purchase Order Management

• Create, issue, and manage purchase orders with approved suppliers to support customer orders and inventory replenishment.

• Ensure purchase orders are accurate, complete, and aligned with company purchasing policies.

• Update purchase orders as required due to customer demand changes, supplier delays, pricing adjustments, or shipping updates.

• Confirm order acknowledgments and maintain accurate expected delivery dates.

Supplier Communication & Follow-Up

• Build and maintain professional relationships with suppliers.

• Proactively monitor supplier commitments and follow up on open orders to ensure on-time delivery.

• Identify and resolve issues related to lead times, pricing discrepancies, shipping delays, and product availability.

• Escalate potential supply risks and recommend solutions to minimize disruptions.

Inventory & Demand Management

• Monitor inventory levels and purchasing requirements to help prevent stock shortages and excess inventory.

• Review historical sales trends, forecasts, and inventory reports to support buying decisions.

• Assist in maintaining inventory levels that support customer demand while optimizing inventory investment.



Reporting & Data Accuracy

• Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier correspondence, pricing agreements, and supporting documentation.

• Reconcile daily purchasing and open order reports to ensure accurate shipment visibility.

• Analyze purchasing data and identify opportunities to improve purchasing efficiency and inventory performance.

• Support reporting initiatives by providing accurate purchasing information and updates.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Sales to support customer delivery requirements and expedite critical orders when necessary.

• Provide regular updates to Warehouse and Operations regarding incoming shipments and delivery schedules.

• Collaborate with Accounting to resolve invoice discrepancies and purchasing-related issues.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Compliance & Quality

• Understand and follow all Quality Management System (QMS) procedures applicable to the position.

• Maintain compliance with company policies, purchasing procedures, and documentation standards.

• Ensure purchasing activities support company quality objectives and operational requirements.

________________________________________

Key Competencies

Organization & Time Management

• Effectively prioritize multiple tasks and responsibilities while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Maintain accurate records and consistently follow up on open action items.

Communication

• Communicate professionally and effectively with suppliers, customers, and internal stakeholders.

• Provide timely and accurate updates regarding order status, delays, and potential risks.

Problem Solving

• Investigate purchasing, inventory, and supplier-related issues and identify practical solutions.

• Take initiative to resolve challenges before they impact customer deliveries.

Analytical Thinking

• Utilize data, reports, and trends to support purchasing decisions.

• Evaluate inventory levels, lead times, and purchasing costs to support operational objectives.

Attention to Detail

• Demonstrate accuracy in purchase order creation, order maintenance, reporting, and supplier communications.

• Ensure information entered into company systems is complete and reliable.

Customer Focus

• Understand the importance of internal and external customer satisfaction.

• Support company objectives by helping ensure products are available when customers need them.

Adaptability & Continuous Learning

• Demonstrate a willingness to learn new systems, products, suppliers, and processes.

• Embrace change and continuously seek opportunities to improve performance and efficiency.

title: Revenue Management Analyst (Short-Term Rentals)
description:
About the Role

We manage a portfolio of short-term rental properties and are looking for a Revenue Management Analyst to own day-to-day pricing execution and performance analysis. This is a hands-on analytical role, not a strategy-only position. You will be in the data every day, adjusting rates, spotting anomalies, and explaining what the numbers are telling us.



Responsibilities

Set and adjust nightly rates, minimum stays, and length-of-stay rules across a portfolio of listings

Monitor pace, pickup, and booking windows against the same period last year and against budget

Run competitive set and market analysis (compression dates, events, seasonality, local demand shifts)

Build and maintain pricing models and reporting in Excel or Google Sheets

Produce weekly and monthly performance reporting on ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, and RevPAU, with clear commentary on what changed and why

Flag underperforming listings and recommend corrective action

Audit rate and calendar data for errors across the PMS and channel manager

Support forecasting and budget preparation



Required Background

2 to 4 years of revenue management experience in vacation rentals or short-term rentals; hotel revenue management experience is also acceptable

A quantitative academic background: mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering, actuarial science, or a closely related field

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and building models from scratch

Comfort working with large data sets and drawing conclusions from them independently

Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to write a clear analytical summary a non-analyst can act on

Reliable overlap with our working hours and consistent communication



Nice to Have

Experience with a revenue management tool such as PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, or Beyond

Familiarity with Airbnb, Vrbo, and 
 channel dynamics

Experience with a PMS such as Hostaway or Guesty

SQL, Python, or R for data work

BI or dashboard experience (Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau)



Who This Is For

This is a mid-level role. We are not looking for a director or a consultant, and we are not looking for someone who has only ever executed someone else's pricing rules. The right person is analytical, self-directed, and can defend a pricing decision with data.



Location

Fully remote. Location is not a limitation, but strong written and spoken English is required.



To Apply

Tell us in a few sentences about a portfolio you managed, its size, and one specific pricing decision you made that moved RevPAR. Include the tools you used.

title: Content Producer & Strategist (Video + Distribution)
description:
About Dragon Lab

Dragon Lab is an emerging media platform and movement founded by neurosurgeon, Zen Buddhist priest, and author Patrick Codd. Each week we publish one thoughtful, long-form essay exploring medicine, neuroscience, leadership, identity, Zen, and the healing power of presence. That essay serves as the foundation for videos, graphics, interviews, and multi-platform conversations.



We are looking for someone who cares about meaningful storytelling and wants to help build a lasting editorial brand, not simply chase viral trends.



Job Overview & Role Context

We are seeking a highly motivated Content Producer & Strategist who thinks like a producer, not just an editor. You will own the production quality and distribution ecosystem surrounding Dragon Lab. 



Each week, the founder creates one original long-form essay along with a short, behind-the-scenes reflection video (60–90 seconds). Your job is to transform this raw material into a coordinated week of polished content and manage its distribution across all major platforms.



You are not expected to invent the core concepts or write the essays. Your role is to package, produce, publish, distribute, and continuously optimize the content engine.



Platform Focus

• Primary Growth: TikTok & Instagram Reels (high engagement, community building)

• Secondary Reach: YouTube Shorts,
, LinkedIn (selective posting, matching a professional tone), and Substack.



Core Responsibilities

• Video Production & Editing: Review raw footage provided by the team; edit 4–6 high-quality short-form vertical videos per week using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. Add captions, tasteful motion graphics, music, and platform-specific pacing.

• Strategic Hook Extraction: Read each weekly essay to identify the strongest emotional or intellectual hooks. Craft engaging video openings while preserving Dragon Lab's authentic, authoritative voice.

• Visual Asset Creation: Design quote graphics, carousel posts, video thumbnails, and cover images using Canva.

• Daily Market Awareness: Active monitoring of TikTok and Instagram to find overlapping communities, trending formats, and relevant discussions.

• Daily Briefing: Send a quick daily update to the team with 3–5 posts/conversations we should respond to and 2–3 fresh content ideas.

• Logistics & Scheduling: Manage all upload pipelines, optimize metadata (titles, tags, descriptions), cross-link back to Dragon Lab, and schedule posts.

• Analytics & Iteration: Track performance data weekly. Review analytics to identify winning patterns, provide feedback on what is working, and prepare a concise weekly report with actionable recommendations.



Weekly Workflow (Envisioned)

• Input Received: 

- 1 long-form essay,

- 1 short reflection video (60–90 seconds),

- and supporting images when available.



• Output Delivered: 

- 4–6 short-form videos,

- custom quote graphics,

- carousel posts,

- platform-specific captions,

- scheduled deployment across all networks,

- and a weekly performance report.



Skills & Experience

• Proven experience editing vertical short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).

• Proficiency with CapCut, Canva, and professional software (Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve).

• Deep understanding of social media platform algorithms, hook structures, pacing, and viewer retention.

• Excellent English communication skills (written and visual).

• Highly organized, proactive, and dependable.



Bonus Points for:

• Experience with Riverside, Photoshop, or advanced motion graphics.

• Thoughtful integration of AI editing tools.

• A proven track record of growing creator accounts.



Future Growth

Over time, you will work closely with a Dragon Lab Fellow (a medical student), who will focus heavily on audience insights, deep editorial research, and new content ideas. This allows you to focus fully on maximizing production execution, distribution systems, and overall visual quality.



Application Process & Interview Steps

To apply, please submit your application directly through this job post. Please ensure you include a link to your portfolio or examples of your previous short-form video work and visual graphic designs.



Our selection process follows these stages:

1. Initial Screening & Review: We will review your background and portfolio to evaluate your video editing style and layout consistency.

2. Alignment Call: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a brief alignment call to discuss the role, expectations, and culture fit.

3. Paid Trial Project: The top 3 finalists will proceed to a paid trial project using an active Dragon Lab Substack essay and its companion reflection video. For this trial, you will be asked to deliver:

- One Instagram Reel

- One LinkedIn-native video

- One TikTok edit

- One quote graphic

- One carousel post

- A brief one-week distribution plan



We are evaluating editorial judgment, storytelling instincts, layout consistency, and your ability to preserve an authentic brand voice, not just technical software skills.



No Outside Communication: Any outreach attempt made outside of the official application channels will result in automatic disqualification. We respect professional boundaries and seek a specialist who follows established systems.

BIG Bonus Tiers (see below)

ONLY APPLICATIONS VIA THE FORM WILL BE REVIEWED



About the Role

We are not hiring for a skill set. We are hiring for a personality.

This role exists because people — creators, editors, teammates — perform better when someone genuinely cares about them, follows through on what they say, and brings energy to every interaction. The tasks are learnable. The personality is not.



If you are the type of person who naturally remembers details about people, follows up without being asked, lights up when you find a hidden gem, and makes everyone around you feel like they matter — this role was designed for you. If you need a script to have a real conversation, this probably is not the right fit.



We are a fast-moving performance marketing team and this role is the connective tissue between our creators, our editors, and our operations. You will be the reason good people want to join us and the reason they stay.



The kind of person we are looking for

- Before we get into what you will be doing, here is who you need to be:

- A natural connector. You genuinely enjoy people. Not in a forced, professional way — in a real way. You remember names, you follow up, you check in. People feel seen when they talk to you.

- Proactive by default. You do not wait to be told. You notice what needs to happen and you handle it. If something is about to go wrong, you say so before it does.

- A hunter. Finding people — whether it is a creator on TikTok or an editor hiding in a competitor agency — excites you. You enjoy the search.

- Warm but professional. You can build real relationships with creators and candidates while still holding them accountable to deadlines and agreements. You are not a pushover — you are just easy to work with.

- Unafraid of direct conversations. You can follow up firmly, deliver feedback clearly, and have honest conversations without making it weird.

- Genuinely curious about what makes people tick. You think about culture fit, motivation, and personality — not just skills and experience.



What You Will Be Doing

- UGC Creator Management

     *Primary point of contact for all UGC creators — from brief delivery through raw file submission

     *Send scripts and briefs, stay on top of deadlines, follow up when things go quiet, and make sure revisions get handled without dragging the timeline

     *Organize raw creator files and hand them off cleanly to the editing team

     *Build and maintain a living creator roster — rated, annotated, and ready to pull from so we are never starting from scratch

     *Negotiate rates and manage agreements that keep quality high and costs sensible

     *Own all creator follow-up — check-ins, reminders, delivery confirmations



- UGC Talent Sourcing

     *Actively hunt for new creators on TikTok, Instagram, and wherever good talent is hiding

     *Vet for delivery, believability, and energy — not follower count

     *Match creators to scripts based on personality and how they actually come across on camera

     *Internal Talent Acquisition

     *Scout for strong video editor candidates across LinkedIn,
, TikTok, and the broader creative community

     *Research competitor agencies and DTC brands to find people worth approaching

     *Keep a warm pipeline of potential hires going at all times so we are never scrambling when a seat opens

     *Handle the full top-of-funnel — profile screening, outreach, scheduling, paid test briefs

     *Run first-round interviews and give the Ops Manager a clear read on culture fit, communication, and work ethic



- People Operations

     *Track daily attendance and logins and surface a clean morning summary to the Ops Manager

     *Flag patterns before they become problems

     *Own new hire logistics end to end — docs, agreements, tool access — so everything is sorted before Day 1

     *Be the person who remembers birthdays, sends the hype messages, and makes the team feel like a team

     *Take on research tasks as assigned and deliver clean summaries, not data dumps



What Success Looks Like

The creator bench is always stocked. The hiring pipeline never hits zero. The team feels taken care of. And the Ops Manager is not thinking about any of it because you already handled it.



You will know you are doing well when:

- Creators are submitting on time and revisions are rare

- We always have at least 3–5 strong editor candidates ready to evaluate

- New hires arrive on Day 1 with everything already set up

- The team feels genuinely supported — not just managed



Compensation and Benefits

- Base pay: $1,000 – $1,500/month depending on experience

- UGC performance bonus — tied to conversions generated by creators you source and manage:

     *250 conversions ? $250

     *500 conversions ? $500

     *750 conversions ? $750

     *1,000 conversions ? $1,000

     *1,250 conversions ? $1,250

     *1,500 conversions ? $1,500

     *2,000+ conversions ? $2,000

- Hiring bonus — $100 for every editor successfully hired and onboarded through your pipeline



Time off:

- 14 paid days off per year

- Observes a selection of US and Philippine holidays



Growth:

- Dedicated coaching in communication and leadership

- Real opportunities to develop skills, build systems, and grow with the company — this role has a clear path to taking on more as the team scales

Job Title



K–12 Virtual Tutor (Priority: SAT & ACT Preparation)



Employment Type



Remote | Part-Time / Contract



Reports To



Academic Operations Manager / Tutor Success Lead



Location



Remote (Open to qualified international candidates)



About Spark Xplorer



Spark Xplorer is a fast-growing online education company committed to providing personalized, high-quality tutoring for K–12 students, primarily within the United States. We combine experienced educators, technology, and AI-powered learning tools to help scholars build confidence, close learning gaps, and achieve academic excellence.



As our scholar community continues to grow, we are expanding our global tutor network by recruiting passionate educators who can deliver engaging, student-centered virtual lessons.



Position Summary



We are seeking highly motivated and experienced K–12 Virtual Tutors to provide engaging online instruction to students following the U.S. curriculum.



Priority will be given to tutors who are experienced in preparing students for standardized examinations such as the SAT and ACT.



Successful candidates should possess excellent communication skills, strong subject expertise, and the ability to adapt lessons to meet individual student needs while maintaining a positive virtual learning environment.

Instruction & Teaching

Prepare students for quizzes, exams, assignments, and standardized tests.

Help students improve target scores for college admissions.

Encourage curiosity and confidence.

Use questioning techniques to deepen understanding.

Parent Communication

Share student progress updates.

Highlight learning achievements and areas for improvement.

Escalate concerns through the appropriate Spark Xplorer channels.

Progress Reporting

Record student attendance and participation.

Document learning progress and recommendations.

Maintain accurate academic records.

Google Workspace

Screen-sharing software

Spark Xplorer platform

Approved AI tools to improve lesson preparation and student learning

Professional teaching environment

Protect student confidentiality.

Reading

Science

English

description:
Role Summary: 

The Logistics Support Specialist provides administrative and operational support to the Logistics Department in managing order fulfillment, transportation coordination, core returns, and warranty-related logistics activities. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate records, coordinating documentation, updating internal systems, monitoring shipment status, and supporting day-to-day logistics operations to ensure timely and efficient execution of business processes.



Core Responsibilities: 

- Provide administrative support for the logistics department to the entire logistics department.

- Prepare, organize, and maintain logistics documentation, records, and shipment files.

- Create, update, and monitor shipment records in company systems and trackers.

- Coordinate shipment scheduling and communicate with carriers, customers, vendors, and internal departments as needed.

- Track shipment status and provide updates to relevant stakeholders.

- Assist in processing shipping documents including Bills of Lading (BOL), Proofs of Delivery (POD), carrier confirmations, and related records.

- Maintain accurate records of serial numbers, shipment details, return information, and supporting documentation.

- Monitor open logistics transactions and follow up on pending items to ensure timely completion.

- Support warranty and core return processes by collecting, organizing, and updating required documentation and records.

- Assist with freight-related inquiries, documentation requests, and issue resolution.

- Ensure logistics files and records are complete, accurate, and maintained in accordance with company procedures.

- Prepare reports, summaries, and administrative documentation as requested by management.

- Perform other logistics and administrative support duties as assigned



Qualifications:

- Minimum of 5 years of professional work experience, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience in logistics administration, transportation support, supply chain coordination, or a similar logistics-related role supporting U.S. operations.

- Experience working with shipping documentation, transportation coordination, order processing, or logistics administration.

- Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy.

- Proficient in Google Suits, Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams.



Relevant qualifications are an advantage but not required:

- Experience supporting order fulfillment, transportation, or warehouse-related processes 

-  Strong knowledge and experience in US LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) Logistics

- Familiarity with freight, carrier coordination, shipment tracking, and logistics documentation

title: Creative Strategist for D2C E-commerce Brand — Meta Ads (Long-term, $3200/month))
description:
We're a fast-growing D2C e-commerce brand from the Netherlands, selling beauty/hair care products to women 50+ in NL and Belgium. Meta is our main channel and creatives are our growth engine.



We're looking for a creative strategist who works like a scientist, not an artist. Research first, data always, systems over vibes.



How we expect you to think:

- You reverse engineer winning ads before creating new ones: format, avatar, mass desire, emotion, angle, hook type. Whether it was intentional or not, you find out why it won so we can repeat it with intention

- You understand copywriting fundamentals: awareness levels, market sophistication, mass desire, angles vs. messaging (Eugene Schwartz framework — if you know it, you'll fit right in). You can have your own style and process, as long as this thinking is behind it

- You read creative metrics: hook rate, hold/watch score, click score. And you know what action each one triggers

- You work in a weekly rhythm: iterate on winners, ideate from research, imitate proven competitor formats. Test, analyze, repeat, every week



What you'll do:

- Deep customer research: reviews, ad comments, competitor ads, forums, VOC data

- Develop concepts and angles based on awareness levels and market sophistication

- Write briefs and scripts for UGC videos, statics, and VSL-style ads

- Manage and direct our video editors: clear briefs, feedback rounds, quality control. You own the creative output end to end

- Analyze performance and iterate: double down on winners, kill losers

- Help us build a systematic internal creative process



Creatives run in Dutch. You don't need to speak Dutch — you deliver concepts, hooks, and briefs in English, we handle localization. Your job is the thinking and the structure.



Requirements:

- Proven experience as creative strategist for D2C brands on Meta

- Experience managing/directing video editors

- Structured, proactive, clear and fast communication

- Some overlap with CET (Netherlands time)

- Experience with motionapp is a plus



Details:

- $3200/month

- Long-term, start part-time with room to grow to full-time



How to apply: Record a short Loom video (5-10 min) where you walk us through your system for producing winning ads: your process from research to concept to brief to analysis, and how you iterate based on data. Screen share your actual work if you can (concepts, briefs, results). Include the Loom link in your application, plus your availability in hours per week.



No Loom = no reply. We want to see how you think, not read a template.

title: Senior Conversion-Focused Visual Designer Needed – Elevate High-Converting Sales Page Wireframe Design (Figma
description:
We have a strong, conversion-oriented sales page wireframe for a $97 3-evening AI training program aimed at 45–55 year old professionals. The structure, hierarchy, and emotional flow are already solid and tested against conversion principles for this skeptical, night-reading audience.



What we need now is a senior visual designer who can take this wireframe to the next level.



The goal is not a pretty, trendy, or “beautiful” design that risks hurting conversions.  

The goal is a design that feels powerful, valuable, and premium — something that stands out from the typical high-converting but generic sales page look. It should feel like a high-value product without looking expensive or flashy.



We need someone who can actually think and improve the design, not just polish what’s already there or lean heavily on AI for ideas. Real experience (ideally 7–15+ years) designing high-converting pages for professional/info-product audiences is important.



What we have:

- Detailed wireframe PDF (sectioned and numbered for easy reference)

- Clear copy and hierarchy already locked

- Strong emotional arc and conversion structure



What we need from you:

- Elevate the visual design while protecting (and ideally improving) conversion

- Move the design into Figma and build a proper, reusable Figma system (not just a one-off page). This system will be used for the middle and back-end pages as well as any future pages we add to the site, so it must be dialed in correctly from the start

- Improve typography, visual hierarchy, and emphasis on key areas

- Strengthen the treatment of visual images and supporting graphics within the page

- Refine the overall wireframe, spacing, card treatments, and look and feel so the page feels premium and differentiated

- Keep the design highly readable for a tired 50-year-old reading at night



Important:

We care more about conversion effectiveness and perceived value than aesthetic beauty. If it looks “pretty” but weaker for this audience, it’s the wrong direction. We want the final result to feel extremely valuable without looking expensive.



Ideal candidate:

- Strong track record with sales pages or long-form product pages for professional / mid-career audiences

- Can show examples of work that feels premium and valuable without being flashy

- Comfortable taking an existing wireframe and elevating it with original thinking

- Experienced in Figma and able to set up a clean, scalable design system



Please include:

1. 2–3 relevant examples of sales or product pages you’ve designed. Please choose the ones most similar to what we’re asking for rather than sending a large portfolio dump.

2. Brief note on how you approach elevating a conversion-focused wireframe without hurting performance

3. Your availability and rough timeline for a Figma design and system



We already have a wireframe that is relatively close. It is solid and conversion-oriented, but right now it still looks a little too generic. You will not be starting from scratch. We need the design elements tightened, the typography and emphasis improved, the visual treatments elevated, and the overall look made more differentiated from the usual boring high-converting sales pages. It’s good enough as it stands, but we are not aiming for good enough. We want something exceptional.



If you feel you’re up for that challenge, tell us why and let’s get started. We may have more work for the right person going forward. If you also have experience with 
, you may be able to help implement the final design once the improved Figma system is complete.



Please put the word spaghetti in the subject line so we know you read the full instructions.

Applicants who have experience creating luxury event designs, wedding mock-ups, proposal decks, or AI-generated video concepts are strongly preferred.



Please include examples that show skill with tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Krea/Flux, Kling AI, Nano Banana, Canva, CapCut, or similar platforms. We are looking for someone who can create visuals that feel polished, realistic, elevated, and client-ready.

title: Figma + Squarespace Web Designer
description:
We are looking for a thoughtful web designer to support our small digital team.



We build websites and brand systems for therapists, mental health practices, and other care-based businesses. Most of the work involves Figma designs, Squarespace websites, and WordPress/Elementor projects.



This role is for someone who understands website design, not just graphic design.



A good website is not just a bunch of pretty sections. It needs structure, hierarchy, spacing, flow, clear calls to action, and a design that actually makes sense for the platform it will be built on.



You would be joining our design team and reporting to our Head of Design.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to make social media graphics. We need someone who can help with real website design, client-facing projects, and platform-aware layouts.





Important requirement:



You must be fluent in Tagalog and English (sorry, no exceptions)



Most communication will be in English, but we are specifically looking for someone who can also communicate comfortably in Tagalog when needed.







What you’ll be working on:



  You may help with:



- Website layouts in Figma

- Homepage and service page designs

- Squarespace website designs and builds

- WordPress/Elementor design layouts

- Designing in a way that can actually be built cleanly in Squarespace or Elementor

- Brand identity work

- Logo concepts

- Website sections and simple design systems

- Design revisions based on team and client feedback

- Supporting active client projects alongside our design team



Some projects will be very structured. Others will require you to think through the layout and make smart design decisions.





What we’re looking for:



  You should have:



- Strong Figma experience

- Real Squarespace experience

- A good eye for spacing, typography, hierarchy, and flow

- Strong visual design and layout skills

- Ability to design desktop and mobile layouts

- Ability to design with platform limitations in mind

- Ability to read and follow briefs carefully

- Ability to ask questions before going too far in the wrong direction

- Ability to take feedback without getting defensive

- Good communication and reliability



You DO NOT need to be a full WordPress/Elementor developer.



But you do need to understand how to design for WordPress/Elementor so the developer is not guessing or fighting the design later.



That means thinking about:



- Section structure

- Responsive behavior

- Spacing and padding

- Reusable components

- Button styles

- Image sizing

- Mobile stacking

- What should be simple versus what should be custom







What matters here:



A strong portfolio matters.



But the day-to-day work matters more.



We need someone who can slow down enough to understand the brief, think through the page, ask questions when something is unclear, and check their own work before handing it off.



We do not need someone who tries to make every section overly complicated.



We need someone who can make a site feel polished, clean, thoughtful, and easy to understand.



The goal is not just to finish tasks quickly. The goal is to create work that is accurate, intentional, and aligned with the client.





Nice to have:



- WordPress or Elementor familiarity

- Experience designing for therapists, coaches, healthcare, wellness, or service-based businesses

- Logo and branding experience

- Basic understanding of responsive web design

- Comfort working with client copy and turning it into a clear page layout



Hours and pay



- Part-time

- 20-25 hours per week

- $6/hr to $7/hr to start; For someone with strong Figma and real Squarespace experience, we may start at up to $7/hour

- Paid weekly

- Initial 30-day probationary period



This is a long-term role for the right person.







How to apply:





Please
 your application directly to:







Use the subject line:



Figma + Squarespace Designer Application - [Your Favorite Filipino Snack]



Please include:



- 2 to 3 Figma website designs

- 2 to 3 live Squarespace websites you personally designed or built

- Any WordPress/Elementor design examples, if you have them

- A short explanation of your role in each project





Please DON'T send just a portfolio link.



For the Figma examples, send the Figma links if you can.



For the Squarespace examples, send the live website links and explain what you personally handled.





Also answer these three questions:



- When designing in Figma, how do you make sure the design can actually be built cleanly in Squarespace?

- If a design is being handed off to a WordPress/Elementor developer, what notes or details do you usually include?

- Just to make sure you read the full post: what is your favorite Filipino snack or comfort food?





One last thing:



We’re excited to see your work, but please take a little time with the application. The strongest applications will show how you think through design, layout, platform limitations, feedback, and handoff, not just which tools you know.



The way you present your application, portfolio links, project examples, and explanations gives us a sense of how you would present website work to our team. Applications that feel generic, copied and pasted, AI-written, disorganized, or hard to follow may not be reviewed closely.



Think of the application as your first small assignment. We’re looking for someone thoughtful, careful, and clear

title: Maintenance Coordinator - Bilingual
description:
PSB (Pro Services Boston) and Green Ocean Property Management are integrated maintenance + property management teams serving the Greater Boston market. We manage multifamily, single-family, and HOA assets and run an in-house service operation focused on speed, quality, and clear communication.



Role Overview:

The Maintenance Coordinator is the command center for all work orders: intake, triage, scheduling, vendor coordination, tenant communications, and close-out. You’ll prioritize urgent issues, keep preventive maintenance on cadence, and drive down cycle times. This is a performance role with clear SLAs, daily accountability rhythms, and growth into senior coordination/ops leadership.



Core Responsibilities:

Work Order Intake & Triage

Receive requests via portal/phone/email; log with complete scope, photos, access info, and priority tag.

Classify by Priority (P0–P3) and building/owner rules; verify warranty/recall/recurring issues.

Pre-diagnose to reduce truck rolls (simple resets, filter sizes, breaker checks, shutoff guidance).

Scheduling & Dispatch

Assign to the right vendor/tech based on trade, SLA, geography, availability, and cost.

Build and update daily/weekly schedules; confirm tenant access, lockbox codes, pet/alarms, parking.

Create and track Not-to-Exceed (NTE) amounts; obtain approvals when required.

Vendor Management

Coordinate licensed vendors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance, roofing, etc.).

Ensure COI/W-9/licenses are current; validate arrival/completion, photo proof, and written diagnosis.

Request quotes for >NTE jobs; compare scope/price; route to approval.

Tenant & Owner Communication

Provide clear ETAs, prep steps (water shutoff, clearing access), and progress updates.

Set expectations for parts lead times and follow-ups; confirm satisfaction at completion.

Escalate sensitively when work impacts health/safety or habitability.

Preventive Maintenance (PM)

Maintain seasonal PM calendars (boilers/furnaces, gutters, dryer vents, smoke/CO checks, filter changes).

Batch/schedule PMs to minimize tenant disruption and travel time; track completion.

Invoicing & Close-Out

Ensure work orders have diagnosis, materials, labor, before/after photos, and time stamps.

Match invoices to WOs, verify against NTE, route exceptions, and submit to accounting the same day.

Emergencies & After-Hours Coordination

Follow the P0/P1 emergency SOP (gas/water/electrical hazards, no-heat, lockouts).

Coordinate on-call vendors, city services, and temporary mitigation.

Reporting & Quality

Produce daily/weekly reports on SLA adherence, WIP aging, cost variance, and vendor performance.

Flag repeat issues, recommend root-cause fixes (access hardware, part stocking, vendor changes).

Qualifications:

Fluent in English and Spanish language

Maintenance coordinating experience in a US Property Management company is a must

Knowledgeable in construction engineering is a plus

Has excellent problem solving skill

Good communication skills in English

Outstanding skills in organizing schedules

Experience with property management software Buildium/Property Meld is a plus

Self-driven and can work with little supervision

Extremely organized and can work in a constantly changing and fast past environment

Want to have a stable career with endless potential for learning and growth

Able to work on EST Business hours

title: Part-Time Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - Web Design Agency (US/UK/AU)
description:
Agentica is a Bulgaria-based digital agency. We build websites and manage online presence for small businesses. We are looking for a part-time cold caller to book appointments for us.



Start small, prove it works, grow into a full-time seat.



How this works?

- We start with a paid 2-week trial

- You choose 2 to 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday

- We track your dials, connects, and appointments booked

- If the numbers are good, we move you to more hours and eventually full time



We are being upfront: this is a small commitment at first because we want to test the process together, not because we are unserious. The trial is paid at full rate from day one. We are building this desk to run permanently, and the first person in is the person who leads it later.



What you'll do?

- Call small businesses from a list we provide - you never build lists, you only call

- Around 20–35 dials per hour

- Get past the small talk, qualify the owner, book a 15-minute appointment

- Log outcomes in our CRM

- Short written end-of-shift summary



Markets and hours

We sell into the UK, the US, and Australia, and we rotate between them depending on which campaign is running. You will not work all three at once. Each campaign block runs for a stretch of days or weeks, and we agree your hours before it starts:

- UK campaigns: afternoon/evening Manila time

- Australia campaigns: morning Manila time

- US campaigns: late night Manila time



Because of this, you need to be genuinely flexible about which part of the day you work. If you can only work mornings, this role is not for you. If you like variety and can adapt, this suits you well.



The offer you'll be pitching?

Most of the businesses we call have no website at all, or one that hasn't been updated in years. We build the site with small upfront cost and they pay a low monthly fee covering hosting, maintenance, updates, and their Google presence. No large cheque to sign means a far easier conversation than most cold calling jobs you have had.



What we need from you?

- Clear, confident, neutral English - Western business owners must be at ease on the phone with you

- Previous outbound calling, BPO, or appointment setting experience

- Stable internet (10 Mbps+), working headset, quiet workspace

- Flexibility on hours across time zones

- Resilience. You will be hung up on constantly. The people who win here treat it as a numbers game and keep dialing.



Compensation

- $3-5 USD per hour, paid weekly via Wise during the trial

- $25 USD per qualified appointment that shows up - uncapped

- Higher hourly rate for US late-night campaigns

- Hours and base rate both increase once you prove the numbers

- Full-time seat available to whoever performs



HOW TO APPLY - we ignore applications that skip this

1. Record a voice clip of yourself, maximum 60 seconds:

"You are calling a small plumbing business. The owner picks up and sounds busy. Open the call and try to get him to agree to a 15-minute chat about his online presence. Improvise - do not read a script."

2. Upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo and put the link at the very top of your application. Begin your application with the word KETTLE so we know you read this fully.

3.Also tell us in one line: which time zone blocks can you realistically commit to?



Applications without a voice clip will not be reviewed.

description:

We are looking for a creative, independent, and results-driven Affiliate Marketing Specialist to promote affiliate links and generate genuine clicks, sign-ups, and sales.



You will have the freedom to choose how and where you distribute the links. You may use social media pages,
 groups, Pinterest, TikTok, blogs, online communities,
 marketing, or other approved marketing methods. You are not restricted to one specific platform or posting strategy.



Your Main Goal



Generate high-quality traffic that converts—not simply random clicks.



Your performance will be based on:



* Affiliate-link clicks

* Click-through rates

* Sign-ups, sales, or other conversions

* Growth in traffic and engagement

* Consistency and overall results



Responsibilities



* Develop and test different affiliate-marketing strategies

* Promote provided affiliate links to relevant audiences

* Create or repurpose promotional content

* Research trending products, topics, keywords, and audience interests

* Track which links, posts, and platforms produce the best results

* Adjust your strategy based on performance

* Provide regular updates showing clicks, conversions, and completed work



AI Tools Are Allowed



You are welcome to use AI tools to help you work more efficiently and produce better results.



AI may be used for:



* Writing captions, posts, scripts, titles, and product descriptions

* Researching keywords, trends, products, and target audiences

* Creating graphics, videos, content calendars, and promotional materials
