AI-generated content must still be reviewed before posting. All information must be accurate, natural, relevant to the audience, and consistent with the brand.



Simply copying and pasting low-quality AI content, publishing misleading information, or creating excessive spam will not be accepted.



Creative Freedom



You may choose the platforms, content formats, AI tools, and promotional methods you believe will produce the strongest results. We care more about genuine traffic and conversions than controlling every step of your process.



However, all marketing must:



* Follow the rules of each platform and affiliate program

* Include affiliate disclosures when required

* Be honest and non-misleading

* Avoid bots, fake clicks, purchased engagement, or fraudulent traffic

* Avoid excessive spam or posting where promotions are prohibited

Great Content ? Increased Reach ? Engaged Audience ? Website Visits ? Direct Bookings ? Repeat Guests

title: Merchandising Manager
description:
About ARDANT

ARDANT is a DTC demi-fine jewelry brand that scaled to eight figures in under two years, selling across the US, UK, Australia, Canada, and Europe. We're building the team that takes us from breakout to a considered, multi-SKU jewelry brand without losing the operational discipline that got us here.



We don't chase trend cycles for the sake of newness. We expand when customer demand is proven, when the unit economics work, and when we can maintain the quality standard our 175,000+ customers expect. The person in this role isn't picking pretty things to put on a website — you're the commercial brain behind what we make, when we make it, how much we make, and what happens when it doesn't sell.



The Role

You own the full product merchandising lifecycle — from identifying what ARDANT should make next, all the way through to clearing the last units of a SKU that didn't land. You sit at the intersection of product, supply chain, marketing, and finance, and you operate within a defined product development cadence across three phases.



What You Own



Ideation

Customer-driven product research. The Founder brings founder-led ideas, the Head of Product/Brand brings brand-aligned concepts, the Product Designer brings trend intelligence — your job is to bring the customer. You mine VOC data and sales performance to identify what customers are asking for, what adjacencies have commercial viability, and what the sell-through potential looks like before a single sketch is drawn.



Quarterly product catalogue brief. You build the brief that defines what we're making and why — grounded in demand signals, competitive white space, margin targets, and inventory position. This isn't a mood board. It's a commercial argument for each SKU: projected sell-through, target margins, pricing rationale, and a clear thesis on who buys it and why.



Sample Production

CAD and sample review. You review supplier CADs against your brief, track the sample timeline, flag delays before they cascade, and evaluate physical samples against commercial intent — not just aesthetics, but whether the product can hit the target price point, fits the assortment architecture, and solves the customer problem it was designed for.



Pass/kill recommendation. You own the recommendation on whether a sample moves to production or gets killed — backed by projected sell-through, margin analysis, cannibalization risk, and the inventory commitment required.



Go-to-Market

Launch coordination. You provide production order details (quantities by variant, inventory allocation) and coordinate across Marketing, Product/Brand, and the Creative Agency to ensure every function has what it needs for a synchronized launch. You're not running the campaign — you're making sure the product side is airtight: right inventory in the right warehouse, product pages live, pricing set, collection architecture sound.



Site merchandising. You own the product onboard to the storefront — product data, variant setup, collection placement, pricing, and the customer's browse and discovery experience.



Post-Launch

This is where most DTC brands drop the ball, and where you earn your keep.



Sell-through tracking. You monitor sell-through by SKU and variant on a weekly cadence with pre-defined action triggers: at what velocity do we reorder? When do we flag a slow mover? At what weeks-on-hand threshold does markdown planning begin?



Markdown and clearance strategy. You own the markdown cadence — timing, depth, channel, and the decision to cut losses. You plan exit strategies at the buying stage, not as a panic response. Every SKU has a clearance plan before it enters production.



Inventory health. You maintain ABC segmentation across the portfolio, track weeks-of-supply, flag reorder points, and prevent both stockouts on top performers and capital trapped in slow movers.



Assortment architecture. You own the ongoing shape of the catalog — hero-to-supporting SKU ratio, breadth vs. depth, seasonal vs. evergreen mix. You make retirement recommendations when a SKU cannibalizes a stronger performer or drags down average order value.



Post-launch retrospectives. After every launch: did sell-through hit projections? Did pricing land? What did post-purchase data reveal? What changes in the next ideation cycle? This closes the loop between your upstream research and real market performance.



KPIs

-Sell-through rate — full-price sell-through by SKU against your own pre-production projections (target: 70%+ within the planned selling window)

-Gross margin by SKU — including the impact of any markdowns you authorize

-Repeat vs. new customer mix — whether new products acquire net-new customers or only convert existing ones

-Weeks of supply — healthy inventory levels without stockouts on winners or excess on tail SKUs

-Markdown rate — percentage of revenue sold at a discount, reflecting the quality of buying decisions upstream

-Dead stock percentage — inventory that reaches end-of-life unsold



What You Bring

Required:



-4+ years in merchandising, buying, or product merchandising at a DTC or digitally-native brand that scaled past $10M+ in annual revenue. You've lived through overstocking, managed markdowns, and made kill decisions on products you personally championed.

-Deep fluency with sell-through analysis, open-to-buy planning, and inventory management frameworks. You think in units and margins, not just aesthetics.

-Experience working with overseas suppliers on sample development, production timelines, and quality control — you've tracked a product from CAD to warehouse.

-Strong cross-functional instincts. You work daily with creative, marketing, and operations, and you hold your ground on commercial decisions while earning trust from people who think in brand terms.

-Data-first operator. You pull your own data and make your own calls — comfortable with analytics dashboards, spreadsheets, and e-commerce reporting tools.



Preferred:



-Experience in jewelry, accessories, or fashion — categories where material costs, variant complexity, and trend timing are real commercial factors.

-Familiarity with demand forecasting tools or inventory planning software.

-Background at a brand with a lean SKU count where every product decision carried outsized commercial impact.



Why This Role Matters Now

ARDANT's next chapter is expanding the assortment without losing the discipline that made the first product work — no vanity launches, no inventory bloat, no margin erosion from reactive discounting. This role is the commercial backbone of that expansion.



To apply: Send your CV and a brief note on the most consequential product kill or markdown decision you've made — what was the situation, what did you d
, and what happened.

title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via
, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: Video Editor for YouTube & Social Media | Long-Term Remote Position
description:

I’m looking for a creative, reliable and detail-oriented remote video editor to help me produce engaging videos for my personal brand.



My content includes:



* Property reviews

* Property market analysis

* Educational real estate videos

* Behind-the-scenes of my work as a property consultant

* Occasional lifestyle and personal content



My goal is simple: I want to educate, build trust with my audience and create content that genuinely helps people make better property decisions.



I’m looking for someone who enjoys storytelling through video and wants to build a long-term working relationship rather than just complete one-off projects.



?



Your Responsibilities



* Edit long-form YouTube videos (typically 8–20 minutes)

* Edit Instagram Reels, TikTok and other short-form videos

* Remove mistakes, pauses and unnecessary sections

* Improve pacing and storytelling to keep viewers engaged

* Organise project files and export videos in the correct formats

?

Someone who:

?

?

title: Executive Assistant to the Founder and CEO
description:
Flexible Part-Time or Full-Time Remote Opportunity



We are looking for a bright, highly organised and adaptable Executive Assistant to support the Founder and CEO of a growing Australian professional services business.



This is not a traditional or repetitive virtual assistant role. You will become a trusted right hand to the Founder, helping him manage both his professional responsibilities and selected aspects of his personal life.



The role will include executive support, customer communication, travel coordination, diary management, administration, social media and a broad range of unexpected tasks and projects.



You may find yourself arranging a business meeting one 
nt, coordinating personal travel the next, speaking with a customer, researching a new idea or helping improve how the business operates.



For the right person, this is an opportunity to gain experience in an unexpected and rewarding professional industry (Australian Mortgage Broking) and potentially progress into a permanent, higher-paying full-time position with increased responsibility.



The Most Important Requirement: Never Miss a Call



The volume of work may be relatively light and will vary throughout the day.



There may be no calls at all, or there may be no calls during the first half of the day and several calls during the afternoon—or the reverse. Calls may be infrequent, but when the phone rings, it must be answered promptly and professionally.



This role does not involve rigid periods where you are formally “on” or “off.” Instead, we will agree on an appropriate salary based on:



* Your skills and experience

* Your availability across Australian business hours

* The expected volume of work

* The responsibilities you are capable of managing

* Whether the position is structured as part-time or full-time



The arrangement can be flexible, but reliable telephone coverage throughout Australian business hours is essential.



Executive and Personal Support



A major part of this position will be helping the Founder and CEO manage his time, priorities and commitments.



Responsibilities may include:



* Managing professional and personal calendars

* Coordinating meetings, appointments and commitments

* Organising domestic and international travel

* Booking flights, accommodation, transport and activities

* Preparing travel itineraries and keeping arrangements organised

* Managing reminders and ensuring important commitments are not overlooked

* Assisting with selected personal appointments, bookings and administrative matters

* Researching services, purchases, destinations or activities

* Following up people and organisations on the Founder’s behalf

* Helping separate urgent priorities from tasks that can be handled later

* Anticipating what may be required before being asked

* Protecting the Founder’s time by reducing unnecessary interruptions and administrative work



You will have access to business and personal information, so discretion, maturity and confidentiality are essential.



Broader Responsibilities



Your responsibilities may also include:



* Answering incoming calls and handling enquiries professionally

* Communicating with customers and internal and external stakeholders

* Monitoring
s, messages and incoming requests

* Recording accurate messages and ensuring follow-up occurs

* Assisting with general administration and record keeping

* Supporting social media and basic content creation

* Entering, reviewing and maintaining information

* Learning new systems and business processes

* Researching unfamiliar topics

* Assisting with process improvements

* Completing unexpected or ad hoc tasks as they arise



No two days will necessarily look the same. We enjoy finding better ways to do things and are looking for someone who is curious, resourceful and comfortable learning as they go.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a great fit if you have:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills

* A warm, confident and professional telephone manner

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Excellent organisation and diary-management skills

* The ability to learn quickly and retain new information

* The ability to manage both business and personal tasks discreetly

* Good judgment when handling confidential or sensitive matters

* The flexibility to move between very different types of tasks

* Initiative and the confidence to solve problems independently

* The ability to anticipate what needs to happen next

* A positive attitude and good sense of humour

* Reliable internet, telephone and computer equipment

* Backup arrangements for power, internet or equipment disruptions



You do not need previous experience in our industry. We are more interested in your reliability, intelligence, communication skills, attention to detail and willingness to learn.



Artificial Intelligence and Productivity



We are enthusiastic about using technology and artificial intelligence to work smarter.



As part of your application, we would appreciate practical examples of how AI has helped you:



* Complete work more efficiently

* Improve written communication

* Organise or summarise information

* Plan travel or manage schedules

* Learn a new task or system

* Automate repetitive work

* Improve accuracy or customer service

* Generate ideas for social media or business activities



We also expect applicants to understand that AI must be used responsibly.



Confidential, personal, financial or commercially sensitive information must not be entered into unapproved AI tools. AI should improve productivity without compromising privacy, security, accuracy or professional judgment.



Please explain both how you use AI and how you ensure sensitive information remains protected.



Flexibility, Salary and Career Potential



This position may be structured preferably as part-time or full-time for the right applicant.



Salary is flexible and will be agreed based on the successful applicant’s:



* Skills and experience

* Availability

* Expected workload

* Phone coverage commitment

* Range of responsibilities

* Ability to support the Founder independently

* Potential to contribute more broadly to the business



The workload may initially be light and variable, but we are looking for someone who can grow with the role.



An applicant who demonstrates reliability, initiative, discretion and strong communication skills may have the opportunity to learn an unexpected but rewarding professional industry, take on more meaningful responsibilities and progress into a higher-paying full-time role.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. A brief and engaging introduction about yourself

2. Your relevant executive assistant, virtual assistant or customer service experience

3. Your availability across Australian business hours

4. Whether you are seeking part-time or full-time work

5. Your salary expectations

6. An explanation of how you would ensure no incoming business call is missed

7. Examples of managing another person’s diary, travel, appointments or priorities

8. An example of a time you anticipated what someone needed before being asked

9. Details of your internet, power and equipment backup arrangements

10. Examples of customer or stakeholder communication you have handled

11. Examples of how AI has made you more productive

12. An explanation of how you protect personal and sensitive information when using AI

13. A short voice recording introducing yourself so we can assess your spoken English, personality and telephone manner



We are looking for someone dependable, intelligent, discreet and adaptable who wants more than a basic task-based role.



You will have the opportunity to become a trusted part of the Founder’s professional and personal support system, contribute ideas, work on varied projects, learn valuable new skills and potentially build a long-term career within the business.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
BestPerfume.Store is hiring a skilled short-form video editor for Meta:
 and Instagram Reels.



This role is **short-form editing only**



## Work Volume



* 3–5 finished videos per week

* Multiple hook variations from the same footage

* Primarily 15–45 second videos

* Consistent ongoing work



## What You Will Edit



* UGC-style videos

* Founder-led videos

* Product demonstrations

* Talking-head content

* Short-form advertisements

* Multiple hook variations from the same core video



## What Good Editing Means to Us



You must know how to:

* Remove dead space without making speech feel unnatural

* Improve pacing and viewer retention

* Select the strongest takes

* Identify weak framing, lighting, positioning and delivery

* Use zooms, cuts, sound effects and motion graphics selectively

* Add subtitles that are clean and easy to read

* Use B-roll and product footage with purpose

* Improve weak footage where realistically possible

* Make content feel native to social media—not like a corporate video

* Keep editing polished without making it loud, childish or cringe

* Add relevant b-roll to reflect what is being said



We prefer editors with good judgment over editors who use the most effects.



## Requirements



* Strong portfolio of short-form content

* Experience editing Reels, TikToks or short-form advertisements

* Strong understanding of pacing, hooks and viewer retention

* Good visual judgment

* Able to identify problems in footage, not just follow instructions

* Reliable communication

* Able to meet deadlines consistently

* Comfortable receiving direct feedback

* Proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or equivalent professional software

* Must provide editable project files when requested



## Important



Do not apply if:

* Your portfolio mainly contains long-form videos

* You rely heavily on CapCut templates

* Every video uses excessive emojis, sound effects and transitions

* You need detailed instructions for every cut

* You cannot explain why you made an editing decision

* You submit generic applications written by AI

If this sounds like you, send your up-to-date portfolio.

title: Loan Processor (Not a Virtual Assistant) — Real Estate Lending, Remote
description:
Read this fully before applying — it will save you time.

We are NOT looking for a virtual assistant. We are looking for someone ambitious who wants to grow into a real Loan Processor in real estate lending — someone who can eventually understand a loan file well enough to explain to a borrower why a document is needed, not just collect it.

This role rewards people who are naturally perceptive — who can read a borrower's hesitation, understand what's really behind their questions or pushback, and respond with the right explanation at the right 
nt. You don't need to have this skill on day one. But you do need the ambition to build it, and the discipline to learn something new about the process, the borrowers, and the psychology behind both — every single day.

What the role actually is:



Understanding loan documents is the job — not a side task. If you don't know how to explain why we need a specific document yet, that's fine, we will teach you. But you need to be ready and hungry to learn this, not just process paperwork on autopilot.

Over time, you'll take ownership of a file from start to finish — talking to borrowers directly, reading their concerns, explaining requirements clearly, and handling pushback with confidence.

This is a role for someone who wants to get sharper every week, not someone looking to coast in a repetitive task.



How pay works:



You start at a base salary while you're learning.

Once you can independently handle a file start to finish, you move to base + bonus per closed file.

This is not a flat task-rate VA gig. Growth in pay comes with growth in responsibility.



Before you apply:

If you're underqualified for this role and the salary shown on the job portal is higher than what you'd realistically expect while learning, tell us upfront in your intro
:



How much you actually want to be paid to start

How fast you're able to learn and take on real responsibility



We will read every intro
. Generic applications with no answer to the above will not be considered.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller — AI Agency (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
THE COMPANY

We are an AI-driven marketing agency that helps established businesses across the United States automate and modernize how they handle inbound leads and calls — primarily through AI receptionist/voice agent systems, with premium website builds as a secondary offer. Our clients are business owners in industries like roofing, HVAC, construction, med spas, chiropractic, and other high-ticket service businesses. These are not startups — they are existing businesses that are already making money and ready to invest in systems that capture more of the revenue they're currently leaving on the table.

We are growing fast and looking for a driven, organized, and persistent appointment setter to join our team remotely.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your primary job is to cold call and set appointments for our sales team with leads we provide for you. Once an appointment is made, you must also notify our sales team with all relevant information to the appointment.



Cold Calling:



Make outbound calls to business owners during US business hours using our dialer

Follow a proven script — we will provide it

Qualify leads — are they an established business with revenue? Are they missing calls or losing leads to voi
? Do they have a weak website or no website? Are they open to improving how they handle inbound calls and leads?

Handle objections confidently and professionally

Book qualified appointments on our sales rep's calendar using a scheduling tool



Follow-Up:



Follow up with leads who did not answer on the first attempt — minimum 3 attempts per lead before marking as no contact

Send follow-up texts or
s to warm leads after initial contact

Re-engage old leads who were interested but did not book

Keep your lead tracker updated in real time — every call logged, every outcome noted



Additional Responsibilities:



Research competitor websites and phone/booking setups for industries you are calling so you can speak intelligently about what an AI receptionist or better website would do for them

Flag any leads who seem especially hot to the sales team immediately

Suggest new industries or niches to target based on what you are seeing in the market

Help build and refine the script over time based on what objections come up most



WHO THIS IS FOR

This person is the right fit if they:



Have done cold calling or outbound sales before and are not afraid of rejection

Are comfortable working inside a dialer and hitting daily call targets

Are extremely organized — you live in your spreadsheet and your calendar

Communicate clearly and professionally in English — written and spoken

Are self-motivated — you do not need someone to tell you to make calls

Are comfortable finding their own leads from scratch every day

Have reliable internet and a quiet place to work

Are available during US business hours — at minimum 9am to 5pm in at least one US time zone

Are motivated by results, not clocked hours — this is a fully commission-based role



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

Do not apply if:



You have never made cold calls before and are not willing to learn fast

You need someone to hand you a list every day

You are looking for a passive or low-effort role, or want guaranteed hourly pay

You give up after one or two rejections

Your English is not strong enough to have a confident business conversation



COMPENSATION

This is a COMMISSION-ONLY role — there is no base or hourly pay.



$10 per qualified appointment that shows up to the call, starting rate

Up to $200 per closed deal, starting rate

Both rates scale up based on performance — consistent high performers earn more per appointment and per close over time

This role has room to grow — the right person can move from setter to closer, with commission on deals they close directly

A top caller can make upwards of 100$ in pure commission



WHAT A GREAT DAY LOOKS LIKE



250–300 dialer calls made daily

5–10 qualified appointments booked daily

Every call logged with outcome and notes

Follow-ups sent to all warm leads from the week prior

Lead tracker fully up to date by end of Friday



Note on performance: call volume is the activity standard, not the success metric. You're evaluated on appointments shown and deals closed — not on dials made. Someone hitting 300 calls with no shows is not outperforming someone hitting 250 calls and booking consistently.

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered you must do the following exactly — applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



Start your application with the subject line or first line: "MALIBU READY"

Write 3–5 sentences about your cold calling experience — be specific, not general

Tell us what industry you would target first and why

Tell us what you would say in the first 10 seconds of a cold call to a roofing company owner

Include your resume or work history



Applications that do not start with "MALIBU READY" will be automatically filtered out. This is intentional. It tells us you read carefully and follow instructions — two things this job requires every single day.

ADDITIONAL TASKS THIS SAME PERSON CAN OWN

Here's everything else you can stack onto this role that a good appointment setter can handle without it becoming a different job:



CRM data entry — logging all calls, outcomes, and follow-ups into a shared sheet or CRM tool

Prospect research — building lead lists for new industries or cities before calling begins

 outreach — sending cold
s to businesses that didn't answer the phone, following a template

Social media lead gen — finding business owners through
 groups, Instagram, or LinkedIn who might be a fit

Script testing — trying different openers and reporting back what gets the best response rate

Appointment confirmation — texting or
ing booked leads 24 hours before their appointment to reduce no-shows

No-show re-engagement — calling back people who missed their appointment to reschedule

Competitor research — identifying businesses in each niche with bad websites or no call-handling system and flagging them as priority targets

Weekly reporting — sending a simple end-of-week report: calls made, appointments booked, no contacts, follow-ups pending

title: Backend Operations Manager
description:
About Us



We are a fast-growing jewelry brand for women, serving customers across the US and Europe. We are a lean, performance-driven team that moves fast, holds high standards, and genuinely enjoys working together. As we scale, we are looking for a strong Backend Operations Manager who can own the entire operational backend and grow with us.



What You Step Into



You are not starting from scratch. We have built a solid foundation for you to work from and improve on:



A fully integrated internal software system that covers all key operational areas, with existing SOPs already in place that you are encouraged to refine and improve over time

Internal sheets and dashboards that give you a clear, real-time view of performance across all backend departments

Direct access to the founders and other department heads, with short communication lines and fast decision-making

A motivated, high-quality team that is genuinely invested in doing good work

A structured environment where processes exist, but there is still room to make your mark



The Role



This is a senior, fully remote, full-time position. You will be the central pillar of our backend operations, managing a cross-functional team and ensuring that everything behind the scenes runs smoothly, efficiently, and at a high level. You report directly to the founders and have real ownership over your domain.



What You Will Own



Full operational management of the backend, including customer service, supply chain, dispute management, and inventory

Leading, coaching, and holding accountable a team of backend staff (CS agents, supply chain, and dispute roles)

Overseeing all customer service operations: quality control, response times, escalation handling, and policy enforcement

Managing supplier communication and the end-to-end supply chain: order flow, stock levels, and issue resolution

Owning dispute and chargeback management: prevention strategies, response processes, and win-rate tracking

Monitoring inventory levels, flagging low-stock risks, and coordinating replenishment with suppliers

Reviewing, maintaining, and where needed improving existing SOPs across all backend departments

Reporting weekly to the founders on key backend metrics: refund rates, chargeback rates, response times, team performance

Identifying bottlenecks proactively and proposing solutions before they become problems



What We Are Looking For



Minimum 2 years of experience in a comparable backend management or operations manager role

Proven experience managing a team of at least 10 people simultaneously

Background in e-commerce is required. Fashion dropshipping experience alone does not qualify

Fluent English, both written and spoken, is a hard requirement

Strong understanding of customer service operations, including quality control and escalation handling

Hands-on experience with dispute and chargeback management

Comfortable working with data and metrics. You track what matters and act on it

Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple departments and priorities at once

Excellent written communication skills for both internal team management and external escalations

Experience writing and maintaining SOPs

Self-directed and reliable. You do not need to be micromanaged

Familiarity with tools such as Reamaze, Shopify, or similar e-commerce and CS platforms is a strong plus



How to Apply



We only accept applications through a short Loom video. Please record a video of approximately 1 minute where you introduce yourself and walk us through your relevant experience. Keep it natural and clear. Tell us who you are, what kind of backend operations you have managed, what size of team you have led, and what kind of results you delivered.



Applications submitted without a Loom video will not be reviewed.

title: Telemarketing / Cold Caller – Real Estate Investor Outreach
description:
Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week. Split shift: 3 days 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST, 2 days 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM EST. Hours may vary. 



About Us:

We're a fast-growing real estate lead generation company based in the US. We connect motivated home sellers with real estate investors, wholesalers, and flippers looking to grow their business. Our reputation depends on bringing investors real, qualified opportunities. That's where this role comes in.



Job Overview:

We need a confident, personable Telemarketer/Cold Caller to call real estate investors (wholesalers, flippers, buy-and-hold buyers) and get them interested in becoming clients. You'll build rapport quickly, explain what we offer, qualify their interest, and schedule appointments for our sales team to close. Most of this is working leads from our own database, though there may be some cold calling on a cold list in the future. Consistency, a confident phone presence, and hitting your daily numbers matter here.



Key Responsibilities:

- Make outbound calls to real estate investors from our database

- Engage investors and build rapport quickly

- Clearly explain our services and qualify their level of interest

- Schedule appointments for our sales team/closers

- Accurately document call outcomes and notes in the CRM

- Follow up with prospects as needed

- Meet daily and weekly activity goals

- Maintain a professional, confident attitude on every call

- Be open to cold calling a new list as needed down the line



What We're Looking For:

- Must have a fluent American accent. No accent other than American English will be considered.

- Confident on the phone, comfortable with high call volume

- Excellent spoken and written English, able to speak credibly with business owners and investors

- Self-motivated and goal-oriented

- Resilient, doesn't get discouraged by rejection or a slow stretch of calls

- Comfortable with CRMs and dialer systems



Requirements:

- Previous telemarketing, cold calling, appointment setting, inside sales, B2B sales, or customer service experience is preferred but not required

- Quiet home workspace, reliable internet

- Available for a split shift schedule (10-6 or 12-9 EST depending on the day), 40 hrs/week, including weekend availability

- Basic computer proficiency



What We Offer:

- Base pay + commission (details discussed during interview)

- Comprehensive training and ongoing support

- CRM and dialer system access, all tools provided

- Existing lead database

- Growth opportunities based on performance



How to Apply:

Submit your resume and a Loom video answering (Required):

1. Tell us about your experience with outbound and cold calling, especially calling business owners or professionals rather than consumers.

2. Walk us through how you build credibility and rapport quickly with someone who doesn't know you or your company.

3. How do you handle rejection or a string of "no's" without it affecting your energy on the next call?

4. Describe a time you turned a skeptical or busy prospect into a scheduled appointment. What did you say or do?

5. Describe your past experience working in a role like this.

6. How do you keep focused and hit your numbers working remotely?

7. How do you make sure you're accurately documenting call notes and not making mistakes in the CRM?

8. How good are you at thinking on your feet? Give an example.

9. What do you do for fun? Do you have any hobbies?

10. Show us your work setup (camera pan of your space).

11. Do you have a backup power source?

12. Do you have 2 screens? What are your computer specs?

13. Do you have a microphone headset?

14. Do you have a quiet space to work?

15. Send a picture of your internet speed test (e.g. speedtest.net result).

title: Procurement Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role



Win Big Bids is a growing government contracting and procurement company. We find bid opportunities, source products from suppliers in the US and overseas, and deliver winning proposals to our clients. We are hiring a Procurement Virtual Assistant for a role split between two areas: supporting our bid pipeline from start to finish, and sourcing talent as we grow the team. You will find bids, research suppliers, and prepare bid packets, while also posting jobs, screening candidates, and supporting hiring and onboarding.



What You Will Do

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Find bids: Research and identify new bid opportunities that match our capabilities

• Source suppliers: Identify and contact suppliers and manufacturers in the US and overseas, request quotes, compare pricing, and follow up on responses

• Manage the pipeline: Enter bids into our system, upload supplier responses and documents, and keep records accurate and organized

• Prepare bid packets: Compile submission documents, verify specs and quantities, and make sure every bid is complete and ready to submit on time

• Manage checklists: Create and complete a checklist for each bid and flag missing or incomplete items before deadlines

• Communicate: Give timely updates on bid status, supplier responses, and open items

• Source talent: Post job openings, source candidates, screen resumes and introductory videos, and schedule interviews

• Support hiring: Coordinate applications, contracts, and onboarding paperwork for new team members



What We Are Looking For

• Strong written and spoken English for supplier
s and calls

• Comfortable making phone calls to suppliers and manufacturers

• Organized, detail oriented, and deadline driven

• Experience with Microsoft Word and Excel

• Experience with ClickUp, GoHighLevel, or similar tools is a plus but not required. Training is provided.

• Reliable computer, stable internet, and a working phone or calling setup

• Prior procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or VA experience is a plus

• Recruiting, HR, or candidate screening experience is a plus



Schedule and Pay

• $5.00 per hour, paid on a biweekly schedule

• 8 hours per day, worked as a split shift: 8:00 PM to 12:00 AM EST and 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM EST

• You must be reachable during your scheduled hours and keep communication lines open

• Fully remote, applicants from any location are welcome



Training and Growth



We provide full training on our bid pipeline, supplier sourcing process, checklists, and internal systems. The engagement begins with a 3 month trial period. Strong performers will have the opportunity to grow with the company as we scale, including expanded responsibilities and potential long term or full time engagement.

How to Apply



Send your resume, portfolio, and a short introductory video telling us about yourself and your experience with sourcing, procurement, or administrative support to 
 Candidates who move forward will complete a brief application and interview.



Win Big Bids is looking to hire quickly. Qualified candidates will be contacted within a few business days.
